The\n    /// trailer is fully consumed and its CRC checked.\n    pub fn next_record(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Record>> {\n        if self.finished {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let first = match self.r.read_u8()? {\n            Some(b) => b,\n            None => return Err(Error::corrupt(\"EOF inside run (no trailer)\")),\n        };\n        if first == END_MAGIC[0] {\n            let mut rest = [0u8; 7];\n            self.r.read_exact(&mut rest)?;\n            let mut end = [0u8; 8];\n            end[0] = first;\n            end[1..].copy_from_slice(&rest);\n            if &end != END_MAGIC {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\"bad trailer magic during merge\"));\n            }\n            let mut payload = [0u8; 12];\n            self.r.read_exact(&mut payload)?;\n            let mut tcrc = [0u8; 4];\n            self.r.read_exact(&mut tcrc)?;\n            if Crc32::checksum(&payload) != u32::from_le_bytes(tcrc) {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\"trailer CRC mismatch during merge\"));\n            }\n            if self.r.read_u8()?.is_some() {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\"trailing garbage after run trailer\"));\n            }\n            self.finished = true;\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n\n        let mut header = vec![0u8; FRAME_HEADER_LEN];\n        header[0] = first;\n        self.r.read_exact(&mut header[1..])?;\n        let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(header[0..8].try_into().unwrap());\n        let ulen = u32::from_le_bytes(header[8..12].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;\n        let want_crc = u32::from_le_bytes(header[12..16].try_into().unwrap());\n\n        let mut line = vec![0u8; ulen];\n        self.r.read_exact(&mut line)?;\n\n        let mut crc = Crc32::new();\n        crc.update(&header[..12]);\n        crc.update(&line);\n        if crc.finish() != want_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(format!(\"frame CRC mismatch during merge (seq={seq})\")));\n        }\n        Ok(Some(Record { seq, line }))\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d7df961a-9a98-4448-8b8f-664f5ecca60b","session_id":"4a952caf-71e9-4549-8807-edf2596ee0ac","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/b","sessionId":"4a952caf-71e9-4549-8807-edf2596ee0ac","version":"2.1.278","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp2-b","slug":"stateful-mapping-coral"}

Composite key extraction and comparison.\n//!\n//! A key spec is a list of key parts. Each part selects one tab-separated\n//! field of the line (field 0 is the whole line) and compares it bytewise,\n//! optionally descending:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! \"2:asc,1:desc\"   -> first by field 2 ascending, then field 1 descending\n//! \"3\"              -> field 3 ascending only\n//! \"0\" / \"\"         -> whole line ascending\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Separators: parts are separated by `;` and the field index from its\n//! direction by `:` (this leaves `,` free inside data). Ties that remain after\n//! all key parts are equal are broken by the record's original input sequence\n//! number, always ascending — that is what makes the sort stable for duplicate\n//! keys.\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::format::Record;\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Direction {\n    Asc,\n    Desc,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct KeyPart {\n    /// 0 means the whole line; n >= 1 means the nth tab-separated field.\n    pub field: usize,\n    pub dir: Direction,\n}\n\nimpl KeyPart {\n    pub fn asc(field: usize) -> Self {\n        KeyPart { field, dir: Direction::Asc }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct KeySpec {\n    pub parts: Vec<KeyPart>,\n}\n\nimpl KeySpec {\n    /// Default: whole-line ascending.\n    pub fn default_key() -> Self {\n        KeySpec { parts: vec![KeyPart::asc(0)] }\n    }\n\n    /// Parses query/CLI syntax. Empty string means the default key.\n    pub fn parse(spec: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        if spec.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(Self::default_key());\n        }\n        let mut parts = Vec::new();\n        for raw in spec.split(';') {\n            let raw = raw.trim();\n            if raw.is_empty() {\n                return Err(Error::bad(\"empty key part\"));\n            }\n            let (field_s, dir_s) = match raw.split_once(':') {\n                Some((f, d)) => (f.trim(), Some(d.trim())),\n                None => (raw, None),\n            };\n            let field: usize = field_s\n                .parse()\n                .map_err(|_| Error::bad(format!(\"invalid field index in key part '{raw}'\")))?;\n            let dir = match dir_s {\n                None | Some(\"asc\") | Some(\"1\") => Direction::Asc,\n                Some(\"desc\") | Some(\"-1\") => Direction::Desc,\n                Some(other) => {\n                    return Err(Error::bad(format!(\n                        \"invalid direction '{other}' in key part '{raw}' (want asc|desc)\"\n                    )))\n                }\n            };\n            parts.push(KeyPart { field, dir });\n        }\n        if parts.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::bad(\"key spec has no parts\"));\n        }\n        Ok(KeySpec { parts })\n    }\n\n    pub fn canonical(&self) -> String {\n        self.parts\n            .iter()\n            .map(|p| match p.dir {\n                Direction::Asc => format!(\"{}:asc\", p.field),\n                Direction::Desc => format!(\"{}:desc\", p.field),\n            })\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\";\")\n    }\n\n    /// Compare two records by the composite key, then by sequence number\n    /// (ascending) for stability.\n    pub fn cmp(&self, a: &Record, b: &Record) -> std::cmp::Ordering {\n        for part in &self.parts {\n            let av = field_bytes(&a.line, part.field);\n            let bv = field_bytes(&b.line, part.field);\n            let ord = av.cmp(bv);\n            if ord != std::cmp::Ordering::Equal {\n                return match part.dir {\n                    Direction::Asc => ord,\n                    Direction::Desc => ord.reverse(),\n                };\n            }\n        }\n        // Stability: original input order always wins ties.\n        a.seq.cmp(&b.seq)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Returns the selected field as bytes. Field 0 is the whole line; fields\n/// beyond the end of the record compare as empty (the usual SQL-ish rule).\nfn field_bytes(line: &[u8], field: usize) -> &[u8] {\n    if field == 0 {\n        return line;\n    }\n    let mut start = 0;\n    for i in 1..field {\n        match line[start..].iter().position(|&b| b == b'\\t') {\n            Some(p) => start += p + 1,\n            None => return &[],\n        }\n        let _ = i;\n    }\n    match line[start..].iter().position(|&b| b == b'\\t') {\n        Some(p) => &line[start..start + p],\n        None => &line[start..],\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use std::cmp::Ordering::*;\n\n    fn rec(seq: u64, line: &str) -> Record {\n        Record { seq, line: line.as_bytes().to_vec() }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn parse_specs() {\n        assert_eq!(KeySpec::parse(\"\").unwrap(), KeySpec::default_key());\n        assert_eq!(\n            KeySpec::parse(\"2:desc;1:asc\").unwrap().parts,\n            vec![KeyPart { field: 2, dir: Direction::Desc }, KeyPart::asc(1)]\n        );\n        assert!(KeySpec::parse(\"x\").is_err());\n        assert!(KeySpec::parse(\"1:sideways\").is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn whole_line_and_fields() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"0\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&rec(0, \"apple\"), &rec(1, \"banana\")), Less);\n\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"1\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(0, \"zeta\\t1\");\n        let b = rec(1, \"alpha\\t2\");\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Greater); // field 1: zeta > alpha\n\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"2\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less); // field 2: 1 < 2\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn descending_and_composite() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"1:desc;2:asc\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(0, \"x\\t1\");\n        let b = rec(1, \"x\\t2\");\n        let c = rec(2, \"y\\t0\");\n        // y desc -> after x; within x, field2 1 before 2\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less);\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &c), Greater);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn duplicate_keys_are_stable() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"1\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(5, \"same\\tx\");\n        let b = rec(9, \"same\\tx\");\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less); // earlier seq first regardless of key\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&b, &a), Greater);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn missing_field_treated_as_empty() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"5:desc\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(0, \"onlyonefield\");\n        let b = rec(1, \"onlyonefield\");\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less); // tie broken by seq\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_332bcc5c2e33394d83193c22","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3958,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":1961,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_pporjtl5ilxboixtag8pow5v":{"content":"//! Empty string means the default key.\n    pub fn parse(spec: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        if spec.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(Self::default_key());\n        }\n        let mut parts = Vec::new();\n        for raw in spec.split(';') {\n            let raw = raw.trim();\n            if raw.is_empty() {\n                return Err(Error::bad(\"empty key part\"));\n            }\n            let (field_s, dir_s) = match raw.split_once(':') {\n                Some((f, d)) => (f.trim(), Some(d.trim())),\n                None => (raw, None),\n            };\n            let field: usize = field_s\n                .parse()\n                .map_err(|_| Error::bad(format!(\"invalid field index in key part '{raw}'\")))?;\n            let dir = match dir_s {\n                None | Some(\"asc\") | Some(\"1\") => Direction::Asc,\n                Some(\"desc\") | Some(\"-1\") => Direction::Desc,\n                Some(other) => {\n                    return Err(Error::bad(format!(\n                        \"invalid direction '{other}' in key part '{raw}' (want asc|desc)\"\n                    )))\n                }\n            };\n            parts.push(KeyPart { field, dir });\n        }\n        if parts.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::bad(\"key spec has no parts\"));\n        }\n        Ok(KeySpec { parts })\n    }\n\n    pub fn canonical(&self) -> String {\n        self.parts\n            .iter()\n            .map(|p| match p.dir {\n                Direction::Asc => format!(\"{}:asc\", p.field),\n                Direction::Desc => format!(\"{}:desc\", p.field),\n            })\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\";\")\n    }\n\n    /// Compare two records by the composite key, then by sequence number\n    /// (ascending) for stability.\n    pub fn cmp(&self, a: &Record, b: &Record) -> std::cmp::Ordering {\n        for part in &self.parts {\n            let av = field_bytes(&a.line, part.field);\n            let bv = field_bytes(&b.line, part.field);\n            let ord = av.cmp(bv);\n            if ord != std::cmp::Ordering::Equal {\n                return match part.dir {\n                    Direction::Asc => ord,\n                    Direction::Desc => ord.reverse(),\n                };\n            }\n        }\n        // Stability: original input order always wins ties.\n        a.seq.cmp(&b.seq)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Returns the selected field as bytes. Field 0 is the whole line; fields\n/// beyond the end of the record compare as empty (the usual SQL-ish rule).\nfn field_bytes(line: &[u8], field: usize) -> &[u8] {\n    if field == 0 {\n        return line;\n    }\n    let mut start = 0;\n    for i in 1..field {\n        match line[start..].iter().position(|&b| b == b'\\t') {\n            Some(p) => start += p + 1,\n            None => return &[],\n        }\n        let _ = i;\n    }\n    match line[start..].iter().position(|&b| b == b'\\t') {\n        Some(p) => &line[start..start + p],\n        None => &line[start..],\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use std::cmp::Ordering::*;\n\n    fn rec(seq: u64, line: &str) -> Record {\n        Record { seq, line: line.as_bytes().to_vec() }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn parse_specs() {\n        assert_eq!(KeySpec::parse(\"\").unwrap(), KeySpec::default_key());\n        assert_eq!(\n            KeySpec::parse(\"2:desc;1:asc\").unwrap().parts,\n            vec![KeyPart { field: 2, dir: Direction::Desc }, KeyPart::asc(1)]\n        );\n        assert!(KeySpec::parse(\"x\").is_err());\n        assert!(KeySpec::parse(\"1:sideways\").is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn whole_line_and_fields() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"0\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&rec(0, \"apple\"), &rec(1, \"banana\")), Less);\n\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"1\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(0, \"zeta\\t1\");\n        let b = rec(1, \"alpha\\t2\");\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Greater); // field 1: zeta > alpha\n\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"2\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less); // field 2: 1 < 2\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn descending_and_composite() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"1:desc;2:asc\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(0, \"x\\t1\");\n        let b = rec(1, \"x\\t2\");\n        let c = rec(2, \"y\\t0\");\n        // y desc -> after x; within x, field2 1 before 2\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less);\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &c), Greater);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn duplicate_keys_are_stable() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"1\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(5, \"same\\tx\");\n        let b = rec(9, \"same\\tx\");\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less); // earlier seq first regardless of key\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&b, &a), Greater);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn missing_field_treated_as_empty() {\n        let k = KeySpec::parse(\"5:desc\").unwrap();\n        let a = rec(0, \"onlyonefield\");\n        let b = rec(1, \"onlyonefield\");\n        assert_eq!(k.cmp(&a, &b), Less); // tie broken by seq\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b4d19af0-3eb2-496e-aab3-98b426b753d2","session_id":"4a952caf-71e9-4549-8807-edf2596ee0ac","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/b","sessionId":"4a952caf-71e9-4549-8807-edf2596ee0ac","version":"2.1.278","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp2-b","slug":"stateful-mapping-coral"}

Job manifest: the authoritative recovery state.\n//!\n//! Stored at `jobs/<job>/manifest.txt` and rewritten atomically (temp + fsync\n//! + rename + dir-fsync) on every state transition. Each non-comment line is\n//! one record:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! v1\n//! key=<canonical key spec>\n//! mem=<bytes>\n//! buf=<bytes>\n//! fanin=<effective k>\n//! run 000001 runs/run-000001.tmp final-name runs/run-000001.exs <count> <aggr_crc>\n//! merge r00 000001 merges/... <count> <aggr_crc> inputs=runs/run-000001.exs;...\n//! state DONE\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Recovery rule: runs form an ordered prefix. If a run is missing on disk or\n//! fails verification, it and *every later run plus all merge entries* are\n//! discarded, and the engine replays the input from the record following the\n//! last good run. Merge entries are only trusted when their referenced inputs\n//! match the deterministic merge plan for the surviving run set and the merge\n//! output itself verifies; otherwise the whole merge phase is redone.\n\nuse std::io::Write;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::fs::{BufWriter, Fs};\n\nconst MANIFEST_VERSION: &str = \"v1\";\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct RunEntry {\n    pub index: u64,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub count: u64,\n    pub aggr_crc: u32,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct MergeEntry {\n    pub round: u32,\n    pub step: u32,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub count: u64,\n    pub aggr_crc: u32,\n    pub inputs: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// Immutable configuration recorded with the job; a resumed run must match it.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct JobConfig {\n    pub key_canonical: String,\n    pub mem: usize,\n    pub buf: usize,\n    pub fanin: usize,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub config: Option<JobConfig>,\n    pub runs: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merges: Vec<MergeEntry>,\n    pub done: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Manifest {\n    pub fn new(config: JobConfig) -> Self {\n        Manifest { config: Some(config), runs: Vec::new(), merges: Vec::new(), done: false }\n    }\n\n    pub fn config(&self) -> Result<&JobConfig> {\n        self.config.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| Error::corrupt(\"manifest missing config\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Serialises and atomically replaces the manifest (write → fsync → rename\n    /// → dir-fsync).\n    pub fn save(&self, fs: &dyn Fs, manifest_rel: &str, tmp_rel: &str, dir_rel: &str, io_buf: usize) -> Result<()> {\n        let body = self.serialize();\n        let raw = fs.create_write(tmp_rel)?;\n        let mut w = BufWriter::new(raw, io_buf);\n        w.write_all(body.as_bytes())?;\n        w.sync_all()?;\n        drop(w);\n        fs.rename(tmp_rel, manifest_rel)?;\n        fs.sync_dir(dir_rel)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn serialize(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(MANIFEST_VERSION);\n        s.push('\\n');\n        if let Some(c) = &self.config {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"key={}\\n\", c.key_canonical));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"mem={}\\n\", c.mem));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"buf={}\\n\", c.buf));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"fanin={}\\n\", c.fanin));\n        }\n        for r in &self.runs {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"run {:06} {} {} {}\\n\",\n                r.index, r.rel, r.count, r.aggr_crc\n            ));\n        }\n        for m in &self.merges {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"merge r{:02} {:06} {} {} {} inputs={}\\n\",\n                m.round,\n                m.step,\n                m.rel,\n                m.count,\n                m.aggr_crc,\n                m.inputs.join(\";\")\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.done {\n            s.push_str(\"state DONE\\n\");\n        }\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// Strict parser. Any malformed line is a corruption error; callers\n    /// recovering from a torn manifest handle that at a higher level.\n    pub fn parse(body: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut lines = body.split('\\n');\n        let version = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        if version != MANIFEST_VERSION {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(format!(\"unsupported manifest version: {version:?}\")));\n        }\n\n        let mut m = Manifest::default();\n        let mut saw_state = false;\n        for (lineno, line) in lines.enumerate().map(|(i, l)| (i + 2, l)) {\n            if line.is_empty() {\n                continue; // trailing newline only\n            }\n            let bad = || Error::corrupt(format!(\"manifest line {lineno}: {line:?}\"));\n\n            if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"key=\") {\n                if m.config.is_some() {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                m.config = Some(JobConfig {\n                    key_canonical: v.to_owned(),\n                    mem: 0,\n                    buf: 0,\n                    fanin: 0,\n                });\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"mem=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.mem = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"buf=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.buf = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"fanin=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.fanin = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"run \") {\n                let f: Vec<&str> = rest.split(' ').collect();\n                if f.len() != 4 {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                m.runs.push(RunEntry {\n                    index: f[0].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    rel: f[1].to_owned(),\n                    count: f[2].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    aggr_crc: f[3].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                });\n            } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"merge \") {\n                // merge r00 000001 rel count crc inputs=a;b\n                let f: Vec<&str> = rest.split(' ').collect();\n                if f.len() != 6 || !f[0].starts_with('r') {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                let round: u32 = f[0][1..].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n                let step: u32 = f[1].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n                let inputs: Vec<String> = f[5]\n                    .strip_prefix(\"inputs=\")\n                    .ok_or_else(bad)?\n                    .split(';')\n                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n                    .map(|s| s.to_owned())\n                    .collect();\n                m.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n                    round,\n                    step,\n                    rel: f[2].to_owned(),\n                    count: f[3].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    aggr_crc: f[4].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    inputs,\n                });\n            } else if line == \"state DONE\" {\n                if saw_state {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                saw_state = true;\n                m.done = true;\n            } else {\n                return Err(bad());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Config consistency: either fully present or absent.\n        if let Some(c) = &m.config {\n            if c.mem == 0 || c.buf == 0 || c.fanin == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\"manifest config incomplete\"));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(m)\n    }\n\n    /// Loads the manifest if present; a missing manifest yields the default\n    /// (fresh job). A corrupt manifest is an error rather than silently\n    /// discarded — the caller decides policy.\n    pub fn load(fs: &dyn Fs, rel: &str) -> Result<Option<Manifest>> {\n        if !fs.exists(rel)? {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let mut file = fs.open_read(rel)?;\n        let mut body = Vec::new();\n        let mut chunk = [0u8; 8192];\n        loop {\n            let n = file.read(&mut chunk)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                break;\n            }\n            body.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]);\n        }\n        let body = String::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| Error::corrupt(\"manifest not UTF-8\"))?;\n        Ok(Some(Manifest::parse(&body)?))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn cfg() -> JobConfig {\n        JobConfig { key_canonical: \"0:asc\".into(), mem: 4096, buf: 512, fanin: 4 }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn roundtrip() {\n        let mut m = Manifest::new(cfg());\n        m.runs.push(RunEntry { index: 1, rel: \"runs/x\".into(), count: 3, aggr_crc: 42 });\n        m.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n            round: 0,\n            step: 0,\n            rel: \"merges/y\".into(),\n            count: 3,\n            aggr_crc: 7,\n            inputs: vec![\"runs/a\".into(), \"runs/b\".into()],\n        });\n        let body = m.serialize();\n        let p = Manifest::parse(&body).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(p, m);\n        assert!(!p.done);\n        m.done = true;\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(&m.serialize()).unwrap().done);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_garbage() {\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v2\\n\").is_err());\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nrun x y\\n\").is_err());\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nmem=10\\n\").is_err()); // config incomplete\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nstate DONE\\nstate DONE\\n\").is_err());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6692528fd0bc11408dabe657","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2896,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":51000,"output_tokens":2886,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_tblqd4pxu4hfkka85e6if2kl":{"content":"//! Streaming line reader.\n//!\n//! Unlike `std::io::BufRead::read_line`, this reader never rejects a line for\n//! being \"too long\": the working buffer grows without a fixed cap so that an\n//! arbitrarily large single record is handled correctly. The sort's memory\n//! *budget* only governs how many records are held before a segment is\n//! spilled; an oversized record produces a one-record run on its own.\n//!\n//! Both `\\n` and `\\r\\n` are accepted as line terminators; a final line not\n//! terminated by a newline is still delivered. The terminator bytes are never\n//! included in the returned record.\n\nuse crate::error::Result;\nuse crate::fs::{BufReader, RFile};\n\npub struct LineReader {\n    inner: BufReader<Box<dyn RFile>>,\n    buf: Vec<u8>,\n    pos: usize,\n    len: usize,\n    eof: bool,\n    bytes_read: u64,\n}\n\nimpl LineReader {\n    pub fn new(file: Box<dyn RFile>, io_buf: usize) -> Self {\n        LineReader {\n            inner: BufReader::new(file, io_buf),\n            buf: vec![0u8; io_buf.max(64)],\n            pos: 0,\n            len: 0,\n            eof: false,\n            bytes_read: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn bytes_read(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.bytes_read\n    }\n\n    fn pull(&mut self) -> Result<bool> {\n        if self.eof {\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n        if self.pos > 0 {\n            self.buf.copy_within(self.pos..self.len, 0);\n            self.len -= self.pos;\n            self.pos = 0;\n        }\n        if self.len == self.buf.len() {\n            // A single line spans more than the whole buffer: grow.\n            let new_len = self.buf.len().saturating_mul(2);\n            self.buf.resize(new_len, 0);\n        }\n        let n = self.inner.read(&mut self.buf[self.len..])?;\n        self.bytes_read = self.bytes_read.saturating_add(n as u64);\n        if n == 0 {\n            self.eof = true;\n        } else {\n            self.len += n;\n        }\n        Ok(n > 0)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the next line without terminator, or `None` at EOF.\n    pub fn read_line(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {\n        loop {\n            if self.pos < self.len {\n                if let Some(rel) = self.buf[self.pos..self.len].iter().position(|&b| b == b'\\n') {\n                    let mut end = self.pos + rel;\n                    let start = self.pos;\n                    self.pos = end + 1;\n                    if end > start && self.buf[end - 1] == b'\\r' {\n                        end -= 1;\n                    }\n                    return Ok(Some(self.buf[start..end].to_vec()));\n                }\n            } else if self.eof {\n                return Ok(None);\n            }\n            let had_data = self.pos < self.len;\n            if !self.pull()? {\n                if had_data {\n                    let mut end = self.len;\n                    let start = self.pos;\n {"parentUuid":"c4124868-e29d-43e9-ad72-d3e16f4d3e46","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_yngunxxfgyrmkcxf3z1ae7gh","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/b/src/engine.rs","content":"//! Bounded-memory external sort engine.\n//!\n//! Pipeline:\n//!\n//! 1. **Run formation (phase A).** Input is streamed record by record and\n//!    records are held in memory until the configured budget is reached, then\n//!    sorted in memory (stable sort by composite key) and spilled as a\n//!    verified \"run\" segment (`jobs/<job>/runs/`). Every spill is followed by\n//!    an fsync and a manifest checkpoint, so a crash leaves a prefix of\n//!    complete runs.\n//! 2. **Multi-way merge (phase B).** Runs are merged `k` at a time per level,\n//!    producing new run-format files under `jobs/<job>/merges/`, until one\n//!    file remains. Every merge output is fsynced and checkpointed.\n//! 3. **Finalisation.** The last remaining run is streamed out to\n//!    `jobs/<job>/output.txt` with newlines, fsynced, and the manifest flips\n//!    to `state DONE`.\n//!\n//! Recovery on a subsequent call: verified run prefix + verified matching\n//! merge outputs are reused; everything after the first invalid artifact is\n//! rebuilt. Replay of the input skips records already covered by good runs.\n//!\n//! Memory accounting: `mem` covers the record arena *plus* one I/O buffer\n//! (`buf`) for the writer/reader currently in use, with a safety margin for\n//! allocator overhead. During merging, `k` read buffers and one write buffer\n//! are reserved up front, so the effective fan-in is\n//! `min(requested_k, (mem - margin) / buf - 1)`.\n\nuse std::io::Write;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::format::{self, Record, RunInfo, RunStream, RunWriter};\nuse crate::fs::{BufWriter, Fs};\nuse crate::key::KeySpec;\nuse crate::lreader::LineReader;\nuse crate::manifest::{JobConfig, Manifest, MergeEntry, RunEntry};\n\n/// User-facing sort configuration.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\npub struct SortConfig {\n    pub key: KeySpec,\n    /// Total memory budget in bytes (records + I/O buffers).\n    pub mem: usize,\n    /// I/O buffer size in bytes.\n    pub buf: usize,\n    /// Requested merge fan-in; may be lowered to fit the budget.\n    pub fanin: Option<usize>,\n}\n\nimpl SortConfig {\n    pub fn new(mem: usize, buf: usize) -> Self {\n        SortConfig { key: KeySpec::default_key(), mem, buf, fanin: None }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Counters reported back through the HTTP response headers.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct SortStats {\n    pub input_records: u64,\n    pub runs: u64,\n    pub merge_rounds: u32,\n    pub merge_steps: u64,\n    pub runs_reused: u64,\n    pub merges_reused: u64,\n    pub fanin: usize,\n    pub peak_bytes: usize,\n    pub resumed: bool,\n    pub output_rel: String,\n}\n\npub struct Engine {\n    fs: Arc<dyn Fs>,\n}\n\nimpl Engine {\n    pub fn new(fs: Arc<dyn Fs>) -> Self {\n        Engine { fs }\n    }\n\n    pub fn fs(&self) -> &dyn Fs {\n        self.fs.as_ref()\n    }\n\n    /// Runs (or resumes) the sort for `job_id`. The raw input must already be\n    /// present at `jobs/<job>/input.txt`.\n    pub fn run(&self, job_id: &str, cfg: &SortConfig) -> Result<SortStats> {\n        validate_job_id(job_id)?;\n        let fanin = effective_fanin(cfg.mem, cfg.buf, cfg.fanin.unwrap_or(8))?;\n\n        let job_dir = format!(\"jobs/{job_id}\");\n        let runs_dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/runs\");\n        let merges_dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/merges\");\n        let input_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/input.txt\");\n        let output_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/output.txt\");\n        let manifest_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/manifest.txt\");\n        let manifest_tmp = format!(\"{job_dir}/manifest.tmp\");\n\n        self.fs.create_dir_all(&runs_dir)?;\n        self.fs.create_dir_all(&merges_dir)?;\n        self.remove_tmp_files(&job_dir)?;\n\n        if !self.fs.exists(&input_rel)? {\n            return Err(Error::not_found(format!(\"input for job '{job_id}'\")));\n        }\n\n        let recorded = JobConfig {\n            key_canonical: cfg.key.canonical(),\n            mem: cfg.mem,\n            buf: cfg.buf,\n            fanin,\n        };\n\n        let mut stats = SortStats {\n            fanin,\n            output_rel: output_rel.clone(),\n            ..Default::default()\n        };\n\n        // ---- Load or create manifest -------------------------------------\n        let mut manifest = match Manifest::load(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel)? {\n            Some(m) => {\n                stats.resumed = true;\n                match &m.config {\n                    Some(existing) if existing == &recorded => m,\n                    Some(existing) => {\n                        return Err(Error::conflict(format!(\n                            \"job '{job_id}' exists with config {existing:?}, requested {recorded:?}\"\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    None => return Err(Error::corrupt(\"manifest without config\")),\n                }\n            }\n            None => Manifest::new(recorded.clone()),\n        };\n\n        // Fast path: previously finished.\n        if manifest.done && self.fs.exists(&output_rel)? {\n            stats.peak_bytes = 0;\n            return Ok(stats);\n        }\n        manifest.done = false;\n\n        // ---- Validate run prefix; truncate after first bad run ------------\n        let mut good_runs: Vec<RunEntry> = Vec::new();\n        for entry in &manifest.runs {\n            match self.verify_entry(entry) {\n                Ok(()) => good_runs.push(entry.clone()),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing_note(&format!(\"run {} not reusable: {e}\", entry.rel));\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        let prefix_truncated = good_runs.len() != manifest.runs.len();\n        if prefix_truncated || !manifest.merges.is_empty() {\n            // Any merge output was derived from the old run set: drop them.\n            for m in &manifest.merges {\n                let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&m.rel);\n            }\n            for r in &manifest.runs[good_runs.len()..] {\n                let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&r.rel);\n            }\n            manifest.runs = good_runs.clone();\n            manifest.merges.clear();\n            manifest.done = false;\n            manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n        }\n\n        let already_ingested: u64 = manifest.runs.iter().map(|r| r.count).sum();\n\n        // ---- Phase A: run formation ---------------------------------------\n        let mut seq = already_ingested;\n        let mut arena: Vec<Record> = Vec::new();\n        let mut arena_bytes = 0usize;\n        let mut peak_bytes = 0usize;\n\n        let flush_threshold = cfg\n            .mem\n            .saturating_sub(cfg.buf)\n            .saturating_sub(OVERHEAD_MARGIN);\n\n        {\n            let input = self.fs.open_read(&input_rel)?;\n            let mut lines = LineReader::new(input, cfg.buf);\n            // Skip records already persisted in good runs.\n            for _ in 0..already_ingested {\n                match lines.read_line()? {\n                    Some(_) => {}\n                    None => return Err(Error::corrupt(\"input shrank below ingested records\")),\n };\n                let len = l.len();\n                arena.push(Record { seq, line });\n                seq += 1;\n                arena_bytes += record_size(len);\n                if arena_bytes > verify_entry(&self, e: &RunEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        let info = format::verify_run(self.fs.as_ref(), &e.rel, 4096)?;\n        if info.count != e.count || info.aggr_crc != e.aggr_crc {\n &self,\n        arena: &mut Vec<Record>,\n        arena_bytes: &mut usize,\n        manifest: &Manifest,\n        runs_dir: &str,\n        cfg: &SortConfig,\n    ) -> Result<RunEntry> {\n        // Stable sort: equal keys preserve their input (seq) order.\n        arena.sort_by(|a, b| cfg.key.cmp(a, b));\n\n        let index = (manifest.runs.len() as u64) + 1;\n        let final_name = format!(\"{runs_dir}/run-{index:06}.exs\");\n        let tmp_name = format!(\"{runs_dir}/run-{index:06}.tmp\");\n        let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&tmp_name);\n\n        let mut writer = cursors[i].current = cursors[i].stream.next_record()?;\n        }\n        let info = writer.finish()?;\n        self.fs.rename(&tmp, &step.rel)?;\n        self.fs.sync_dir(parent_dir(&step.rel))?;\n self.fs.remove_file(&tmp);\n\n        let mut stream = RunStream::open(self.fs.as_ref(), final_run_rel, cfg.buf)?;\n        let raw = self.fs.create_write(&tmp)?;\n        let mut out = 256) / 512 - 1 = 6\n        assert_eq!(effective_fanin(4096, 512, 8).unwrap(), 6);\n        // request wins when smaller\n        assert_eq!(effective_fanin(4096, 512, 3).unwrap(), 3);\n        // floor of 2\n        assert_eq!(effective_fanin(4096, 4096, 8).unwrap(), 2);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn plan_rounds_and_pass_through() {\n        let runs: Vec<RunEntry> = (1..=10).map(|i| run_entry(i, 1)).collect();\n        let plan = build_merge_plan(&runs, 3, \"merges\");\n        // level0: ceil(10/3)=4, level1: ceil(4/3)=2, level2: 1\n        let rounds: Vec<u32> = plan.iter().map(|s| s.round).collect();\n        assert_eq!(plan.len(), 4 + 2 + 1);\n        assert_eq!(*rounds.last().unwrap(), 2);\n        // single run -> no merges\n        let one = build_merge_plan(&[run_entry(1, 1)], 3, \"merges\");\n        assert!(one.is_empty());\n        // exactly k -> one step\n        let two = build_merge_plan(&[run_entry(1, 1), run_entry(2, 1)], 2, \"merges\");\n        assert_eq!(two.len(), 1);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn job_id_validation() {\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"job_1-2\").is_ok());\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"\").is_err());\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"../escape\").is_err());\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"a/b\").is_err());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_27cc9c7aaa71887cbf88d6d7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2215,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":56120,"output_tokens":7457,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_yngunxxfgyrmkcxf3z1ae7gh":{"content":"//! Bounded-memory external sort engine.\n//!\n//! Pipeline:\n//!\n//! 1. **Run formation (phase A).** Input is streamed record by record and\n//!    records are held in memory until the configured budget is reached, then\n//!    sorted in memory (stable sort by composite key) and spilled as a\n//!    verified \"run\" segment (`jobs/<job>/runs/`). Every spill is followed by\n//!    an fsync and a manifest checkpoint, so a crash leaves a prefix of\n//!    complete runs.\n//! 2. **Multi-way merge (phase B).** Runs are merged `k` at a time per level,\n//!    producing new run-format files under `jobs/<job>/merges/`, until one\n//!    file remains. Every merge output is fsynced and checkpointed.\n//! 3. **Finalisation.** The last remaining run is streamed out to\n//!    `jobs/<job>/output.txt` with newlines, fsynced, and the manifest flips\n//!    to `state DONE`.\n//!\n//! Recovery on a subsequent call: verified run prefix + verified matching\n//! merge outputs are reused; everything after the first invalid artifact is\n//! rebuilt. Replay of the input skips records already covered by good runs.\n//!\n//! Memory accounting: `mem` covers the record arena *plus* one I/O buffer\n//! (`buf`) for the writer/reader currently in use, with a safety margin for\n//! allocator overhead. During merging, `k` read buffers and one write buffer\n//! are reserved up front, so the effective fan-in is\n//! `min(requested_k, (mem - margin) / buf - 1)`.\n\nuse std::io::Write;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::format::{self, Record, RunInfo, RunStream, RunWriter};\nuse crate::fs::{BufWriter, Fs};\nuse crate::key::KeySpec;\nuse crate::lreader::LineReader;\nuse crate::manifest::{JobConfig, Manifest, MergeEntry, RunEntry};\n\n/// User-facing sort configuration.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\npub struct SortConfig {\n    pub key: KeySpec,\n    /// Total memory budget in bytes (records + I/O buffers).\n    pub mem: usize,\n    /// I/O buffer size in bytes.\n    pub buf: usize,\n    /// Requested merge fan-in; may be lowered to fit the budget.\n    pub fanin: Option<usize>,\n}\n\nimpl SortConfig {\n    pub fn new(mem: usize, buf: usize) -> Self {\n        SortConfig { key: KeySpec::default_key(), mem, buf, fanin: None }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Counters reported back through the HTTP response headers.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct SortStats {\n    pub input_records: u64,\n    pub runs: u64,\n    pub merge_rounds: u32,\n    pub merge_steps: u64,\n    pub runs_reused: u64,\n    pub merges_reused: u64,\n    pub fanin: usize,\n    pub peak_bytes: usize,\n    pub resumed: bool,\n    pub output_rel: String,\n}\n\npub struct Engine {\n    fs: Arc<dyn Fs>,\n}\n\nimpl Engine {\n    pub fn new(fs: Arc<dyn Fs>) -> Self {\n        Engine { fs }\n    }\n\n    pub fn fs(&self) -> &dyn Fs {\n        self.fs.as_ref()\n    }\n\n    /// Runs (or resumes) the sort for `job_id`. The raw input must already be\n    /// present at `jobs/<job>/input.txt`.\n    pub fn run(&self, job_id: &str, cfg: &SortConfig) -> Result<SortStats> {\n        validate_job_id(job_id)?;\n        let fanin = effective_fanin(cfg.mem, cfg.buf, cfg.fanin.unwrap_or(8))?;\n\n        let job_dir = format!(\"jobs/{job_id}\");\n        let runs_dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/runs\");\n        let merges_dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/merges\");\n        let input_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/input.txt\");\n        let output_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/output.txt\");\n        let manifest_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/manifest.txt\");\n        let manifest_tmp = format!(\"{job_dir}/manifest.tmp\");\n\n        self.fs.create_dir_all(&runs_dir)?;\n        self.fs.create_dir_all(&merges_dir)?;\n        self.remove_tmp_files(&job_dir)?;\n\n        if !self.fs.exists(&input_rel)? {\n            return Err(Error::not_found(format!(\"input for job '{job_id}'\")));\n        }\n\n        let recorded Every spill is followed by\n//!    an fsync and a manifest checkpoint, so a crash leaves a prefix of\n//!    complete runs.\n//! 2. **Multi-way merge (phase B).** Runs are merged `k` at a time per level,\n//!    producing new run-format files under `jobs/<job>/merges/`, until one\n//!    file remains. Every merge output is fsynced and checkpointed.\n//! 3. **Finalisation.** The last remaining run is streamed out to\n//!    `jobs/<job>/output.txt` with newlines, fsynced, and the manifest flips\n//!    to `state DONE`.\n//!\n//! Recovery on a subsequent call: verified run prefix + verified matching\n//! merge outputs are reused; everything after the first invalid artifact is\n//! rebuilt. Replay of the input skips records already covered by good runs.\n//!\n//! Memory accounting: `mem` covers the record arena *plus* one I/O buffer\n//! (`buf`) for the writer/reader currently in use, with a safety margin for\n//! allocator overhead. During merging, `k` read buffers and one write buffer\n//! are reserved up front, so the effective fan-in is\n//! `min(requested_k, (mem - margin) / buf - 1)`.\n\nuse std::io::Write;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::format::{self, Record, RunInfo, RunStream, RunWriter};\nuse crate::fs::{BufWriter, Fs};\nuse crate::key::KeySpec;\nuse crate::lreader::LineReader;\nuse crate::manifest::{JobConfig, Manifest, MergeEntry, RunEntry};\n\n/// User-facing sort configuration.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\npub struct SortConfig {\n    pub key: KeySpec,\n    /// Total memory budget in bytes (records + I/O buffers).\n    pub mem: usize,\n    /// I/O buffer size in bytes.\n    pub buf: usize,\n    /// Requested merge fan-in; may be lowered to fit the budget.\n    pub fanin: Option<usize>,\n}\n\nimpl SortConfig {\n    pub fn new(mem: usize, buf: usize) -> Self {\n        SortConfig { key: KeySpec::default_key(), mem, buf, fanin: None }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Counters reported back through the HTTP response headers.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct SortStats {\n    pub input_records: u64,\n    pub runs: u64,\n    pub merge_rounds: u32,\n    pub merge_steps: u64,\n    pub runs_reused: u64,\n    pub merges_reused: u64,\n    pub fanin: usize,\n    pub peak_bytes: usize,\n    pub resumed: bool,\n    pub output_rel: String,\n}\n\npub struct Engine {\n    fs: Arc<dyn Fs>,\n}\n\nimpl Engine {\n    pub fn new(fs: Arc<dyn Fs>) -> Self {\n        Engine { fs }\n    }\n\n    pub fn fs(&self) -> &dyn Fs {\n        self.fs.as_ref()\n    }\n\n    /// Runs (or resumes) the sort for `job_id`. The raw input must already be\n    /// present at `jobs/<job>/input.txt`.\n    pub fn run(&self, job_id: &str, cfg: &SortConfig) -> Result<SortStats> {\n        validate_job_id(job_id)?;\n        let fanin = effective_fanin(cfg.mem, cfg.buf, cfg.fanin.unwrap_or(8))?;\n\n        let job_dir = format!(\"jobs/{job_id}\");\n        let runs_dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/runs\");\n        let merges_dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/merges\");\n        let input_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/input.txt\");\n        let output_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/output.txt\");\n        let manifest_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/manifest.txt\");\n        let manifest_tmp = format!(\"{job_dir}/manifest.tmp\");\n\n        self.fs.create_dir_all(&runs_dir)?;\n        self.fs.create_dir_all(&merges_dir)?;\n        self.remove_tmp_files(&job_dir)?;\n\n        if !self.fs.exists(&input_rel)? {\n            return Err(Error::not_found(format!(\"input for job '{job_id}'\")));\n        }\n\n        let recorded = JobConfig {\n            key_canonical: cfg.key.canonical(),\n            mem: cfg.mem,\n            buf: cfg.buf,\n            fanin,\n        };\n\n        let mut stats = SortStats {\n            fanin,\n            output_rel: output_rel.clone(),\n            ..Default::default()\n        };\n\n        // ---- Load or create manifest -------------------------------------\n        let mut manifest = match Manifest::load(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel)? {\n            Some(m) => {\n                stats.resumed = true;\n                match &m.config {\n                    Some(existing) if existing == &recorded => m,\n                    Some(existing) => {\n                        return Err(Error::conflict(format!(\n                            \"job '{job_id}' exists with config {existing:?}, requested {recorded:?}\"\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    None => return Err(Error::corrupt(\"manifest without config\")),\n                }\n            }\n            None => Manifest::new(recorded.clone()),\n        };\n\n        // Fast path: previously finished.\n        if manifest.done && self.fs.exists(&output_rel)? {\n            stats.peak_bytes = 0;\n            return Ok(stats);\n        }\n        manifest.done = false;\n\n        // ---- Validate run prefix; truncate after first bad run ------------\n        let mut good_runs: Vec<RunEntry> = Vec::new();\n        for entry in &manifest.runs {\n            match self.verify_entry(entry) {\n                Ok(()) => good_runs.push(entry.clone()),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing_note(&format!(\"run {} not reusable: {e}\", entry.rel));\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        let prefix_truncated = good_runs.len() != manifest.runs.len();\n        if prefix_truncated || !manifest.merges.is_empty() {\n            // Any merge output was derived from the old run set: drop them.\n            for m in &manifest.merges {\n                let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&m.rel);\n            }\n            for r in &manifest.runs[good_runs.len()..] {\n                let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&r.rel);\n            }\n            manifest.runs = good_runs.clone();\n            manifest.merges.clear();\n            manifest.done = false;\n            manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n        }\n\n        let already_ingested: u64 = manifest.runs.iter().map(|r| r.count).sum();\n\n        // ---- Phase A: run formation ---------------------------------------\n        let mut seq = already_ingested;\n        let mut arena: Vec<Record> = Vec::new();\n        let mut arena_bytes = 0usize;\n        let mut peak_bytes = 0usize;\n\n        let flush_threshold = cfg\n            .mem\n            .saturating_sub(cfg.buf)\n            .saturating_sub(OVERHEAD_MARGIN);\n\n        {\n            let input = self.fs.open_read(&input_rel)?;\n            let mut lines = LineReader::new(input, cfg.buf);\n            // Skip records already persisted in good runs.\n            for _ in 0..already_ingested {\n                match lines.read_line()? {\n                    Some(_) => {}\n                    None => return Err(Error::corrupt(\"input shrank below ingested records\")),\n                }\n            }\n\n            loop {\n                let line = match lines.read_line()? {\n                    Some(l) => l,\n                    None => break,\n                };\n                let len = l.len();\n                arena.push(Record { seq, line });\n                seq += 1;\n                arena_bytes += record_size(len);\n                if arena_bytes > peak_bytes {\n                    peak_bytes = arena_bytes;\n                }\n\n                // Flush at the budget boundary. An arena that already holds a\n                // single oversized record still flushes correctly on EOF.\n                if arena_bytes >= flush_threshold {\n                    let entry = self.flush_run(\n                        &mut arena,\n                        &mut arena_bytes,\n                        &manifest,\n                        &runs_dir,\n                        cfg,\n                    )?;\n                    manifest.runs.push(entry);\n                    manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n                }\n            }\n\n            if !arena.is_empty() {\n                let entry = self.flush_run(\n                    &mut arena,\n                    &mut arena_bytes,\n                    &manifest,\n                    &runs_dir,\n                    cfg,\n                )?;\n                manifest.runs.push(entry);\n                manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Empty input: no runs. Emit an empty output directly.\n        stats.input_records = manifest.runs.iter().map(|r| r.count).sum();\n        stats.runs = manifest.runs.len() as u64;\n        stats.runs_reused = if stats.resumed {\n            // Runs present at entry and still valid count as reused.\n            manifest\n                .runs\n                .iter()\n                .take_while(|r| r.index <= already_ingested.max(1) && false)\n                .count() as u64\n        } else {\n            0\n        };\n        // Reused-run accounting is better done below; recompute cleanly.\n        stats.runs_reused = reused_run_count(&manifest, already_ingested, stats.resumed);\n\n        if manifest.runs.is_empty() {\n            self.write_final_output(&output_rel, &[])?;\n            manifest.merges.clear();\n            manifest.done = true;\n            manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n            stats.peak_bytes = peak_bytes;\n            return Ok(stats);\n        }\n\n        // ---- Phase B: k-way merge rounds ----------------------------------\n        // Build the deterministic plan over the surviving run set.\n        let plan = build_merge_plan(&manifest.runs, fanin, &merges_dir);\n\n        // Recover merge outputs: keep only an exact matching prefix of steps.\n        let mut reusable: Vec<bool> = Vec::new();\n        let mut plan_iter = plan.iter();\n        for existing in &manifest.merges {\n            match plan_iter.next() {\n                Some(step) if step.round == existing.round\n                    && step.step == existing.step\n                    && step.rel == existing.rel\n                    && step.inputs\n                        .iter()\n                        .zip(existing.inputs.iter())\n                        .all(|(a, b)| a == b)\n                    && self.verify_manifest_merge(existing).is_ok() =>\n                {\n                    reusable.push(true);\n                }\n                _ => break,\n            }\n        }\n        let keep = reusable.len();\n        if keep != manifest.merges.len() {\n            for m in &manifest.merges[keep..] {\n                let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&m.rel);\n            }\n            manifest.merges.truncate(keep);\n            manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n        }\n\n        let mut current: Vec<String> = if manifest.merges.is_empty() {\n            manifest.runs.iter().map(|r| r.rel.clone()).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Start after the last kept step.\n            let last = manifest.merges.last().unwrap();\n            let inputs_of_last: std::collections::HashSet<&str> =\n                last.inputs.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();\n            let mut v = vec![last.rel.clone()];\n            // Remaining siblings at the same level that were not inputs.\n            let plan_step = &plan[manifest.merges.len() - 1];\n            // Determine the sibling group from the plan.\n            let group_start = plan\n                .iter()\n                .position(|s| s.round == plan_step.round && s.step == plan_step.step)\n                .unwrap();\n            // Find all steps of the same round.\n            let same_round: Vec<&MergeStep> =\n                plan.iter().filter(|s| s.round == plan_step.round).collect();\n            // Inputs to later rounds are the outputs of every step of this round\n            // in order; the resumed stream needs outputs of this round in order\n            // that come after this step.\n            let idx_in_round = same_round\n                .iter()\n                .position(|s| s.step == plan_step.step)\n                .unwrap();\n            for s in &same_round[idx_in_round + 1..] {\n                let _ = inputs_of_last; // not needed\n                v.push(s.rel.clone());\n            }\n            // Plus outputs that feed this round from prior levels beyond this\n            // group — simpler to just rebuild `current` from the plan below.\n            let _ = (group_start, inputs_of_last);\n            v\n        };\n\n        // The reconstruction above is fiddly; derive `current` directly from\n        // the plan + number of completed steps: replay the plan to find the\n        // frontier level.\n        current = self.derive_frontier(&plan, &manifest, fanin, &manifest.runs);\n\n        let mut steps_done = manifest.merges.len();\n        let mut merge_peak: usize = 0;\n        // Peak memory during merges: k read buffers + 1 write buffer + one\n        // in-flight record per cursor.\n        let initial_merge_est = (fanin + 1) * cfg.buf;\n        if initial_merge_est > peak_bytes {\n            peak_bytes = initial_merge_est;\n        }\n\n        // Walk remaining steps; identify the level each belongs to.\n        let mut rounds_seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();\n        for (i, step) in plan.iter().enumerate() {\n            rounds_seen.insert(step.round);\n            if i < steps_done {\n                continue;\n            }\n            let info = self.do_merge(step, cfg, fanin)?;\n            let est = (step.inputs.len() + 1) * cfg.buf;\n            if est > merge_peak {\n                merge_peak = est;\n            }\n            manifest.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n                round: step.round,\n                step: step.step,\n                rel: step.rel.clone(),\n                count: info.count,\n                aggr_crc: info.aggr_crc,\n                inputs: step.inputs.clone(),\n            });\n            manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n            steps_done += 1;\n        }\n        if merge_peak > peak_bytes {\n            peak_bytes = merge_peak;\n        }\n\n        stats.merge_rounds = rounds_seen.len() as u32;\n        stats.merge_steps = plan.len() as u64;\n        stats.merges_reused = manifest\n            .merges\n            .iter()\n            .take(steps_done)\n            .filter(|m| {\n                // counted precisely by keep value; placeholder replaced below\n                false\n            })\n            .count() as u64;\n        stats.merges_reused = keep as u64;\n        let _ = current;\n\n        // ---- Finalise: stream the sole surviving run to output.txt --------\n        let final_rel = final_survivor(&manifest, &plan);\n        self.materialize_output(&final_rel, &output_rel, cfg)?;\n\n        manifest.done = true;\n        manifest.save(self.fs.as_ref(), &manifest_rel, &manifest_tmp, &job_dir, cfg.buf)?;\n\n        stats.peak_bytes = peak_bytes;\n        Ok(stats)\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Helpers\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    fn verify_entry(&self, e: &RunEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        let info = format::verify_run(self.fs.as_ref(), &e.rel, 4096)?;\n        if info.count != e.count || info.aggr_crc != e.aggr_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(format!(\n                \"{}: manifest summary {}/{} mismatches file {}/{}\",\n                e.rel, e.count, e.aggr_crc, info.count, info.aggr_crc\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn verify_manifest_merge(&self, m: &MergeEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        let info = format::verify_run(self.fs.as_ref(), &m.rel, 4096)?;\n        if info.count != m.count || info.aggr_crc != m.aggr_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(format!(\"{}: merge summary mismatch\", m.rel)));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn flush_run(\n        &self,\n        arena: &mut Vec<Record>,\n        arena_bytes: &mut usize,\n        manifest: &Manifest,\n        runs_dir: &str,\n        cfg: &SortConfig,\n    ) -> Result<RunEntry> {\n        // Stable sort: equal keys preserve their input (seq) order.\n        arena.sort_by(|a, b| cfg.key.cmp(a, b));\n\n        let index = (manifest.runs.len() as u64) + 1;\n        let final_name = format!(\"{runs_dir}/run-{index:06}.exs\");\n        let tmp_name = format!(\"{runs_dir}/run-{index:06}.tmp\");\n        let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&tmp_name);\n\n        let mut writer = RunWriter::create(self.fs.as_ref(), &tmp_name, cfg.buf)?;\n        for rec in arena.iter() {\n            writer.write_record(rec)?;\n        }\n        let info = writer.finish()?; // fsync of data\n        self.fs.rename(&tmp_name, &final_name)?;\n        self.fs.sync_dir(runs_dir)?;\n\n        arena.clear();\n        *arena_bytes = 0;\n        Ok(RunEntry { index, rel: final_name, count: info.count, aggr_crc: info.aggr_crc })\n    }\n\n    fn do_merge(&self, step: &MergeStep, cfg: &SortConfig, k: usize) -> Result<RunInfo> {\n        let _ = k;\n        let tmp = format!(\"{}.tmp\", step.rel);\n        let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&tmp);\n\n        let mut cursors: Vec<Cursor> = Vec::with_capacity(step.inputs.len());\n        for rel in &step.inputs {\n            let mut stream = RunStream::open(self.fs.as_ref(), rel, cfg.buf)?;\n            let first = stream.next_record()?;\n            cursors.push(Cursor { stream, current: first });\n        }\n\n        let mut writer = RunWriter::create(self.fs.as_ref(), &tmp, cfg.buf)?;\n        loop {\n            // Select the smallest current record under the composite key;\n            // stability between runs is guaranteed by seq in the comparator.\n            let mut pick: Option<usize> = None;\n            for (i, c) in cursors.iter().enumerate() {\n                if let Some(rec) = &c.current {\n                    match pick {\n                        None => pick = Some(i),\n                        Some(j) => {\n                            if cfg.key.cmp(rec, cursors[j].current.as_ref().unwrap()).is_lt() {\n                                pick = Some(i);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            let i = match pick {\n                Some(i) => i,\n                None => break,\n            };\n            let rec = cursors[i].current.take().unwrap();\n            writer.write_record(&rec)?;\n            cursors[i].current = cursors[i].stream.next_record()?;\n        }\n        let info = writer.finish()?;\n        self.fs.rename(&tmp, &step.rel)?;\n        self.fs.sync_dir(parent_dir(&step.rel))?;\n        Ok(info)\n    }\n\n    fn materialize_output(&self, final_run_rel: &str, output_rel: &str, cfg: &SortConfig) -> Result<()> {\n        let tmp = format!(\"{output_rel}.tmp\");\n        let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&tmp);\n\n        let mut stream = RunStream::open(self.fs.as_ref(), final_run_rel, cfg.buf)?;\n        let raw = self.fs.create_write(&tmp)?;\n        let mut out = BufWriter::new(raw, cfg.buf);\n        while let Some(rec) = stream.next_record()? {\n            out.write_all(&rec.line)?;\n            out.write_all(b\"\\n\")?;\n        }\n        out.sync_all()?;\n        drop(out);\n        self.fs.rename(&tmp, output_rel)?;\n        self.fs.sync_dir(parent_dir(output_rel))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_final_output(&self, output_rel: &str, _records: &[Record]) -> Result<()> {\n        let tmp = format!(\"{output_rel}.tmp\");\n        let _ = self.fs.remove_file(&tmp);\n        let raw = self.fs.create_write(&tmp)?;\n        raw.sync_all()?;\n        drop(raw);\n        self.fs.rename(&tmp, output_rel)?;\n        self.fs.sync_dir(parent_dir(output_rel))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn remove_tmp_files(&self, job_dir: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        for sub in [\"runs\", \"merges\"] {\n            let dir = format!(\"{job_dir}/{sub}\");\n            if !self.fs.exists(&dir)? {\n                continue;\n            }\n            for name in self.fs.list(&dir)? {\n                if name.ends_with(\".tmp\") {\n                    self.fs.remove_file(&format!(\"{dir}/{name}\"))?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Given the deterministic plan and how many merge steps are already\n    /// present and verified, return the file set feeding the *next* step.\n    fn derive_frontier(\n        &self,\n        plan: &[MergeStep],\n        manifest: &Manifest,\n        k: usize,\n        runs: &[RunEntry],\n    ) -> Vec<String> {\n        let done = manifest.merges.len();\n        if done == 0 {\n            return runs.iter().map(|r| r.rel.clone()).collect();\n        }\n        // Simulate levels consuming the plan.\n        let mut level_outputs: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();\n        let mut steps = 0usize;\n        let mut current: Vec<String> = runs.iter().map(|r| r.rel.clone()).collect();\n        while !current.is_empty() && steps < plan.len() {\n            let mut next_level: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n            let mut group: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n            for rel in current.drain(..) {\n                group.push(rel);\n                if group.len() == k {\n                    let rel = plan[steps].rel.clone();\n                    next_level.push(rel);\n                    steps += 1;\n                    group.clear();\n                    if steps >= done && !current.is_empty() {\n                        // frontier mid-round handled by caller recomputing\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if !group.is_empty() {\n                let rel = plan[steps].rel.clone();\n                next_level.push(rel);\n                steps += 1;\n            }\n            level_outputs.push(next_level.clone());\n            current = next_level;\n            if steps >= done {\n                // Return inputs for next step: derive from plan[done].\n                return plan.get(done).map(|s| s.inputs.clone()).unwrap_or_default();\n            }\n        }\n        let _ = level_outputs;\n        Vec::new()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Pure planning / sizing helpers (unit-testable without a filesystem)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst OVERHEAD_MARGIN: usize = 256;\n\nstruct Cursor {\n    stream: RunStream,\n    current: Option<Record>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct MergeStep {\n    pub round: u32,\n    pub step: u32,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub inputs: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// Per-record conservative size: bytes + Vec/Record overhead.\nfn record_size(line_len: usize) -> usize {\n    // Record { seq:8, line:Vec(24) } plus the line allocation rounded up a bit.\n    48 + line_len + line_len / 8\n}\n\nfn effective_fanin(mem: usize, buf: usize, requested: usize) -> Result<usize> {\n    if buf == 0 {\n        return Err(Error::bad(\"buf must be > 0\"));\n    }\n    if mem < buf * 2 + OVERHEAD_MARGIN {\n        return Err(Error::bad(format!(\n            \"mem={mem} too small: need at least 2*buf + {OVERHEAD_MARGIN}\"\n        )));\n    }\n    if requested < 2 {\n        return Err(Error::bad(\"fanin must be >= 2\"));\n    }\n    let by_mem = (mem - OVERHEAD_MARGIN) / buf - 1; // k read buffers + 1 write\n    Ok(requested.min(by_mem).max(2))\n}\n\nfn validate_job_id(job: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    if job.is_empty()\n        || job.len() > 128\n        || !job\n            .chars()\n            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-')\n    {\n        return Err(Error::bad(\"job id must be [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}\"));\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn parent_dir(rel: &str) -> &str {\n    match rel.rfind('/') {\n        Some(i) => &rel[..i],\n        None => \".\",\n    }\n}\n\nfn reused_run_count(manifest: &Manifest, already_ingested: u64, resumed: bool) -> u64 {\n    if !resumed {\n        return 0;\n    }\n    let mut count = 0u64;\n    let mut total = 0u64;\n    for r in &manifest.runs {\n        total += r.count;\n        if total <= already_ingested {\n            count += 1;\n        }\n    }\n    count\n}\n\n/// Builds the full deterministic merge plan: level 0 merges runs, later\n/// levels merge previous level outputs. A level with a single input produces\n/// no step (that file passes through).\npub fn build_merge_plan(runs: &[RunEntry], k: usize, merges_dir: &str) -> Vec<MergeStep> {\n    let mut plan = Vec::new();\n    let mut current: Vec<String> = runs.iter().map(|r| r.rel.clone()).collect();\n    let mut round = 0u32;\n    while current.len() > 1 {\n        let mut next: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        let mut step = 0u32;\n        let mut chunks: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();\n        let mut group: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        for rel in current.drain(..) {\n            group.push(rel);\n            if group.len() == k {\n                chunks.push(std::mem::take(&mut group));\n            }\n        }\n        if !group.is_empty() {\n            chunks.push(group);\n        }\n        for inputs in chunks {\n            let rel = format!(\"{merges_dir}/m-r{round:02}-s{step:03}.exs\");\n            next.push(rel.clone());\n            plan.push(MergeStep { round, step, rel, inputs });\n            step += 1;\n        }\n        current = next;\n        round += 1;\n    }\n    plan\n}\n\nfn final_survivor(manifest: &Manifest, plan: &[MergeStep]) -> String {\n    if let Some(last) = plan.last() {\n        last.rel.clone()\n    } else {\n        manifest.runs[0].rel.clone()\n    }\n}\n\nfn tracing_note(msg: &str) {\n    // Deliberately tiny: surface recovery decisions via stderr in tests/runs\n    // without pulling a logging dependency.\n    eprintln!(\"[extsort] {msg}\");\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn run_entry(index: u64, count: u64) -> RunEntry {\n        RunEntry { index, rel: format!(\"runs/run-{index:06}.exs\"), count, aggr_crc: 0 }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn fanin_respects_budget() {\n        assert!(effective_fanin(100, 64, 8).is_err());\n        // (4096 - 256) / 512 - 1 = 6\n        assert_eq!(effective_fanin(4096, 512, 8).unwrap(), 6);\n        // request wins when smaller\n        assert_eq!(effective_fanin(4096, 512, 3).unwrap(), 3);\n        // floor of 2\n        assert_eq!(effective_fanin(4096, 4096, 8).unwrap(), 2);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn plan_rounds_and_pass_through() {\n        let runs: Vec<RunEntry> = (1..=10).map(|i| run_entry(i, 1)).collect();\n        let plan = build_merge_plan(&runs, 3, \"merges\");\n        // level0: ceil(10/3)=4, level1: ceil(4/3)=2, level2: 1\n        let rounds: Vec<u32> = plan.iter().map(|s| s.round).collect();\n        assert_eq!(plan.len(), 4 + 2 + 1);\n        assert_eq!(*rounds.last().unwrap(), 2);\n        // single run -> no merges\n        let one = build_merge_plan(&[run_entry(1, 1)], 3, \"merges\");\n        assert!(one.is_empty());\n        // exactly k -> one step\n        let two = build_merge_plan(&[run_entry(1, 1), run_entry(2, 1)], 2, \"merges\");\n        assert_eq!(two.len(), 1);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn job_id_validation() {\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"job_1-2\").is_ok());\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"\").is_err());\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"../escape\").is_err());\n        assert!(validate_job_id(\"a/b\").is_err());\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1559cf66-baf1-43e8-a07e-be0278bcbb09","session_id":"4a952caf-71e9-4549-8807-edf2596ee0ac","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/b","sessionId":"4a952caf-71e9-4549-8807-edf2596ee0ac","version":"2.1.278","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp2-b","slug":"stateful-mapping-coral"}
