{"parentUuid":"e6c02367-86f0-49df-99b6-4a8b1014e372","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_f9u7txtzaak4zzjjlfc2pi6k","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/b/src/server.rs","content":"//! Local HTTP validation endpoint.\n//!\n//! Deliberately dependency-free HTTP/1.1 (one request per connection,\n//! `Connection: close`). This server exists to validate the engine over a\n//! real socket — it is not a production web server.\n//!\n//! ## Routes\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! GET  /healthz\n//!      -> 200 \"ok\\n\"\n//!\n//! POST /sort?job=<id>&mem=<bytes>&buf=<bytes>&key=<spec>&fanin=<k>\n//!      body = raw newline-delimited input\n//!      -> 200, body = sorted output, X-Sort-* stat headers\n//!\n//! GET  /sort?job=<id>&mem=<bytes>&buf=<bytes>&key=<spec>&fanin=<k>\n//!      -> resumes / re-runs the same job (no body) and streams the output\n//!\n//! GET  /sort?job=<id>&result=1\n//!      -> streams an already-finished job's output.txt (404 if not done)\n//! ```\n//!\n//! A POST with an existing but unfinished job id acts as resume: the uploaded\n//! body must be empty and the parameters must match the recorded configuration.\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse crate::engine::{Engine, SortConfig, SortStats};\nuse crate::error::Error;\nuse crate::fs::{BufReader, Fs, RealFs};\nuse crate::key::KeySpec;\n\npub struct Server {\n    listener: TcpListener,\n    fs: Arc<dyn Fs>,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn bind(addr: &str, root: &Path) -> std::io::Result<Self> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        let fs: Arc<dyn Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n        fs.create_dir_all(\"jobs\").ok();\n        Ok(Server { listener, fs })\n    }\n\n    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> std::io::Result<std::net::SocketAddr> {\n        self.listener.local_addr()\n    }\n\n    pub fn run(self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        eprintln!(\"[extsort] listening on {}\", self.listener.local_addr()?);\n        for stream in self.listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let fs = self.fs.clone();\n                    thread::spawn(move || {\n                        if let Err(e) = handle_connection(stream.try_clone().unwrap(), fs) {\n                            eprintln!(\"[extsort] connection error: {e}\");\n                        }\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"[extsort] accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Request parsing\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: HashMap<String, String>,\n    content_length: usize,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &TcpStream) -> Result<Request, String> {\n    let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(stream.try_clone().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?);\n    let mut request_line = String::new();\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n    reader.read_line(&mut request_line).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().ok_or(\"missing method\")?.to_owned();\n    let target = parts.next().ok_or(\"missing target\")?;\n    let version = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"HTTP/1.1\");\n    if !version.starts_with(\"HTTP/1.\") {\n        return Err(format!(\"unsupported version {version}\"));\n    }\n\n    let (path, query) = match target.split_once('?') {\n        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_owned(), parse_query(q)),\n        None => (target.to_owned(), HashMap::new()),\n    };\n\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    loop {\n        let mut line = String::new();\n        if reader.read_line(&mut line).map_err(|e| e.to_string())? == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        let line = line.trim_end();\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            break;\n        }\n        if let Some(v) = line.to_ascii_lowercase().strip_prefix(\"content-length:\") {\n            content_length = v.trim().parse().map_err(|_| \"bad content-length\".to_string())?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(Request { method, path, query, content_length })\n}\n\nfn parse_query(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {\n    let mut map = HashMap::new();\n    for pair in q.split('&') {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n            map.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n        } else if !pair.is_empty() {\n            map.insert(percent_decode(pair), String::new());\n        }\n    }\n    map\n}\n\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        if bytes[i] == b'%' && i + 2 < bytes.len() {\n            let h = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[i + 1..i + 3]).ok().and_then(|h| u8::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok());\n            if let Some(b) = h {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 3;\n                continue;\n            }\n        }\n        if bytes[i] == b'+' {\n            out.push(b' ');\n        } else {\n            out.push(bytes[i]);\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Connection handling\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst DEFAULT_MEM: usize = 64 * 1024;\nconst DEFAULT_BUF: usize = 4096;\nconst DEFAULT_FANIN: usize = 8;\nconst MAX_INPUT: u64 = 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 2 GiB guard for this validator\n\nfn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream, fs: Arc<dyn Fs>) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let req = match read_request(&stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            write_simple(&mut stream, 400, &format!(\"bad request: {e}\\n\")).ok();\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    let result = match (req.method.as_str(), req.path.as_str()) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/healthz\") => write_simple(&mut stream, 200, \"ok\\n\"),\n        (\"POST\", \"/sort\") => handle_sort(&mut stream, &fs, &req, true),\n        (\"GET\", \"/sort\") if req.query.contains_key(\"result\") => handle_result(&mut stream, &fs, &req),\n        (\"GET\", \"/sort\") => handle_sort(&mut stream, &fs, &req, false),\n        _ => write_simple(&mut stream, 404, \"not found\\n\"),\n    };\n\n    if let Err(e) = result {\n        let status = e.http_status();\n        let body = format!(\"{e}\\n\");\n        eprintln!(\"[extsort] {} {} -> {status}: {e}\", req.method, req.path);\n        write_simple(&mut stream, status, &body).ok();\n    }\n    stream.flush().ok();\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn parse_usize(q: &HashMap<String, String>, key: &str, default: usize) -> Result<usize, Error> {\n    match q.get(key) {\n        None => Ok(default),\n        Some(v) => v\n            .parse::<usize>()\n            .map_err(|_| Error::bad(format!(\"parameter '{key}' must be an unsigned integer\"))),\n    }\n}\n\nfn build_config(q: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Result<SortConfig, Error> {\n    let mem = parse_usize(q, \"mem\", DEFAULT_MEM)?;\n    let buf = parse_usize(q, \"buf\", DEFAULT_BUF)?;\n    let fanin = match q.get(\"fanin\") {\n        Some(v) => Some(\n            v.parse::<usize>()\n                .map_err(|_| Error::bad(\"parameter 'fanin' must be an unsigned integer\"))?,\n        ),\n        None => Some(DEFAULT_FANIN),\n    };\n    let key = KeySpec::parse(q.get(\"key\").map_or(\"\", String::as_str))?;\n    Ok(SortConfig { key, mem, buf, fanin })\n}\n\nfn handle_sort(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    fs: &Arc<dyn Fs>,\n    req: &Request,\n    has_body: bool,\n) -> Result<(), Error> {\n    let job = req\n        .query\n        .get(\"job\")\n        .cloned()\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"default\".to_owned());\n    if job.is_empty()\n        || job.len() > 128\n        || !job\n            .chars()\n            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-')\n    {\n        return Err(Error::bad(\"job must match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}\"));\n    }\n    let cfg = build_config(&req.query)?;\n\n    let job_dir = format!(\"jobs/{job}\");\n    let input_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/input.txt\");\n    let output_rel = format!(\"{job_dir}/output.txt\");\n    fs.create_dir_all(&job_dir)?;\n\n    let body_len = req.content_length as u64;\n    if has_body {\n        if body_len > MAX_INPUT {\n            return Err(Error::bad(\"input too large for validator (2GiB limit)\"));\n        }\n        if fs.exists(&input_rel)? {\n            // Resume: body must be empty.\n            if body_len != 0 {\n                return Err(Error::conflict(format!(\n                    \"job '{job}' already exists; re-POST without a body or use a new job id\"\n                )));\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Stream body straight to a temp input file using a bounded buffer.\n            let tmp_rel = format!(\"{input_rel}.upload\");\n            let raw = fs.create_write(&tmp_rel)?;\n            let mut writer = crate::fs::BufWriter::new(raw, cfg.buf.max(1024));\n            let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(stream.try_clone()?);\n            let mut buf = vec![0u8; cfg.buf.max(1024)];\n            let mut remaining = body_len as usize;\n            while remaining > 0 {\n                let take = remaining.min(buf.len());\n                reader.read_exact(&mut buf[..take])?;\n                writer.write_all(&buf[..take])?;\n                remaining -= take;\n            }\n            writer.sync_all()?;\n            drop(writer);\n            fs.rename(&tmp_rel, &input_rel)?;\n            fs.sync_dir(&job_dir)?;\n        }\n    } else if !fs.exists(&input_rel)? {\n        return Err(Error::not_found(format!(\n            \"job '{job}' has no input; POST the input first\"\n        )));\n    }\n\n    let engine = Engine::new(fs.clone());\n    let stats = engine.run(&job, &cfg)?;\n    stream_result(stream, &output_rel, fs.as_ref(), &stats, cfg.buf)\n}\n\nfn handle_result(stream: &mut TcpStream, fs: &Arc<dyn Fs>, req: &Request) -> Result<(), Error> {\n    let job = req.query.get(\"job\").ok_or_else(|| Error::bad(\"missing job\"))?;\n    let output_rel = format!(\"jobs/{job}/output.txt\");\n    if !fs.exists(&output_rel)? {\n        return Err(Error::not_found(format!(\"no finished result for job '{job}'\")));\n    }\n    let buf = parse_usize(&req.query, \"buf\", DEFAULT_BUF)?;\n    let stats = SortStats { output_rel: output_rel.clone(), ..Default::default() };\n    stream_result(stream, &output_rel, fs.as_ref(), &stats, buf)\n}\n\nfn stat_headers(stats: &SortStats) -> String {\n    format!(\n        \"X-Sort-Records: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Runs: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Merge-Rounds: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Merge-Steps: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Runs-Reused: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Merges-Reused: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Fanin: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Peak-Bytes: {}\\r\\n\\\n         X-Sort-Resumed: {}\\r\\n\",\n        stats.input_records,\n        stats.runs,\n        stats.merge_rounds,\n        stats.merge_steps,\n        stats.runs_reused,\n        stats.merges_reused,\n        stats.fanin,\n        stats.peak_bytes,\n        if stats.resumed { \"1\" } else { \"0\" },\n    )\n}\n\nfn stream_result(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    output_rel: &str,\n    fs: &dyn Fs,\n    stats: &SortStats,\n    buf_size: usize,\n) -> Result<(), Error> {\n    let meta = std::fs::metadata(fs.root().join(output_rel.trim_start_matches('/')))?;\n    let len = meta.len();\n    write!(\n        stream,\n        \"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\\r\\n\\\n         Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\\r\\n\\\n         Content-Length: {len}\\r\\n\\\n         {}Connection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        stat_headers(stats)\n    )?;\n    stream.flush()?;\n\n    let file = fs.open_read(output_rel)?;\n    let mut reader = BufReader::new(file, buf_size.max(64));\n    let mut buf = vec![0u8; buf_size.max(64)];\n    loop {\n        let n = reader.read(&mut buf)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        stream.write_all(&buf[..n])?;\n    }\n    stream.flush()?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn write_simple(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = reason_phrase(status);\n    write!(\n        stream,\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\n\\\n         Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\\r\\n\\\n         Content-Length: {}\\r\\n\\\n         Connection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    )?;\n    stream.write_all(body.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.flush()\n}\n\nfn reason_phrase(status: u16) -> &'static str {\n    match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"Error\",\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn query_and_percent_decode() {\n        let q = parse_query(\"job=j1&mem=1024&key=1%3Adesc\");\n        assert_eq!(q.get(\"job\").unwrap(), \"j1\");\n        assert_eq!(q.get(\"mem\").unwrap(), \"1024\");\n        assert_eq!(q.get(\"key\").unwrap(), \"1:desc\");\n        assert_eq!(percent_decode(\"a+b%3Bc\"), \"a b;c\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2e9a17965f5e0bbcfa139ef6","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1106,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":4092,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_f9u7txtzaak4zzjjlfc2pi6k":{"content":"//! stat_headers(stats)\n    )?;\n    stream.flush()?;\n\n    let file = fs.open_read(output_rel)?;\n    let mut reader = BufReader::new(file, buf_size.max(64));\n    let mut buf = vec![0u8; Ok(())\n}\n\nfn write_simple(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = reason_phrase(status);\n    write!(\n        stream,\n        \"HTTP/1.1 Command-line entry point.\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! extsort serve <listen-addr> <repo-dir>\n//!     Start the HTTP validation server (default 127.0.0.1:8080 / ./repo).\n//!\n//! extsort verify <input-file> <output-file> [key-spec]\n//!     Independently validate an external-sort result by sorting the input\n//!     fully in memory with Rust's stable slice sort and comparing byte by\n//!     byte. Exits 0 on match, 1 on mismatch.\n//!\n//! extsort --help\n//! ```\n\nuse std::fs::File;\nuse std::io::{BufReader, Read};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse extsort::format::Record;\nuse extsort::key::KeySpec;\nuse extsort::server::Server;\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let prog = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(\"extsort\");\n\n    match args.get(1).map(String::as_str) {\n        Some(\"serve\") => cmd_serve(&args[2..]),\n        Some(\"verify\") => cmd_verify(&args[2..]),\n        Some(\"-h\") | Some(\"--help\") | Some(\"help\") | None => {\n            print_usage(prog);\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        Some(other) => {\n            eprintln!(\"unknown command: {other}\\n\");\n            print_usage(prog);\n            ExitCode::from(2)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn print_usage(prog: &str) {\n    eprint!(\n        \"{p} serve <listen-addr> <repo-dir>\\n\\\n         {p} verify <input-file> <output-file> [key-spec]\\n\\\n         \\n\\\n         key-spec examples: \\\"\\\" (whole line), \\\"1:asc\\\", \\\"2:desc;1:asc\\\"\\n\",\n        p = prog\n    );\n}\n\nfn cmd_serve(args: &[String]) -> ExitCode {\n    let addr = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(\"127.0.0.1:8080\");\n    let root = args.get(1).map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\"repo\"));\n    match std::fs::create_dir_all(&root) {\n        Ok(()) => {}\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"cannot create repo {root:?}: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    }\n    let server = match Server::bind(addr, &root) {\n        Ok(s) => s,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"bind {addr} failed: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    };\n    match server.run() {\n        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"server error: {e}\");\n            ExitCode::FAILURE\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn read_all_lines(path: &str) -> std::io::Result<Vec<Vec<u8>>> {\n    let f = File::open(path)?;\n    let mut reader = BufReader::new(f);\n    let mut data = Vec::new();\n    reader.read_to_end(&mut data)?;\n    let mut lines = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n    for (i, &b) in data.iter().enumerate() {\n        if b == b'\\n' {\n            let mut end = i;\n            if end > start && data[end - 1] == b'\\r' {\n                end -= 1;\n            }\n            lines.push(data[start..end].to_vec());\n            start = i + 1;\n        }\n    }\n    if start < data.len() {\n        lines.push(data[start..].to_vec());\n    }\n    Ok(lines)\n}\n\nfn cmd_verify(args: &[String]) -> ExitCode {\n    let (input, output, key) = match (args.get(0), args.get(1)) {\n        (Some(i), Some(o)) => (i.as_str(), o.as_str(), args.get(2).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(\"\")),\n        _ => {\n            eprintln!(\"verify requires <input-file> <output-file> [key-spec]\");\n            return ExitCode::from(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    let spec = match KeySpec::parse(key) {\n        Ok(s) => s,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"bad key spec: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::from(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    let input_lines = match read_all_lines(input) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"cannot read {input}: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    };\n    let output_lines = match read_all_lines(output) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"cannot read {output}: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Reference: stable sort fully in memory.\n    let mut reference: Vec<Record> = input_lines\n        .into_iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(seq, line)| Record { seq: seq as u64, line })\n        .collect();\n    reference.sort_by(|a, b| spec.cmp(a, b));\n\n    let n = reference.len();\n    if output_lines.len() != n {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"FAIL: record count differs: external={} reference={n}\",\n            output_lines.len()\n        );\n        return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n    }\n    for (i, (got, want)) in output_lines.iter().zip(reference.iter()).enumerate() {\n        if got != &want.line {\n            eprintln!(\"FAIL: first mismatch at record {i}\");\n            eprintln!(\"  external: {}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(got));\n            eprintln!(\"  reference: {}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&want.line));\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    }\n    println!(\"OK: {n} records match in-memory stable reference (key: {})\", spec.canonical());\n    ExitCode::SUCCESS\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_f5dc9e9f8bb49ca1fb3c3ec7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":411,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":83768,"output_tokens":1673,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_j7qxtgay6ilntdghy009ayjw":{"content":"//! Job manifest: the authoritative recovery state.\n//!\n//! Stored at `jobs/<job>/manifest.txt` and rewritten atomically (temp + fsync\n//! + rename + dir-fsync) on every state transition. Each non-comment line is\n//! one record:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! v1\n//! key=<canonical key spec>\n//! mem=<bytes>\n//! buf=<bytes>\n//! fanin=<effective k>\n//! run 000001 runs/run-000001.tmp final-name runs/run-000001.exs <count> <aggr_crc>\n//! merge r00 000001 merges/... <count> <aggr_crc> inputs=runs/run-000001.exs;...\n//! state DONE\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Recovery rule: runs form an ordered prefix. If a run is missing on disk or\n//! fails verification, it and *every later run plus all merge entries* are\n//! discarded, and the engine replays the input from the record following the\n//! last good run. Merge entries are only trusted when their referenced inputs\n//! match the deterministic merge plan for the surviving run set and the merge\n//! output itself verifies; otherwise the whole merge phase is redone.\n\nuse std::io::Write;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::fs::{BufWriter, Fs};\n\nconst MANIFEST_VERSION: &str = \"v1\";\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct RunEntry {\n    pub index: u64,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub count: u64,\n    pub aggr_crc: u32,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct MergeEntry {\n    pub round: u32,\n    pub step: u32,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub count: u64,\n    pub aggr_crc: u32,\n    pub inputs: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// Immutable configuration recorded with the job; a resumed run must match it.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct JobConfig {\n    pub key_canonical: String,\n    pub mem: usize,\n    pub buf: usize,\n    pub fanin: usize,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub config: Option<JobConfig>,\n    pub runs: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merges: Vec<MergeEntry>,\n    pub done: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Manifest {\n    pub fn new(config: JobConfig) -> Self {\n        Manifest { config: Some(config), runs: Vec::new(), merges: Vec::new(), done: false }\n    }\n\n    pub fn config(&self) -> Result<&JobConfig> {\n        self.config.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| Error::corrupt(\"manifest missing config\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Serialises and atomically replaces the manifest (write → fsync → rename\n    /// → dir-fsync).\n    pub fn save(&self, fs: &dyn Fs, manifest_rel: &str, tmp_rel: &str, dir_rel: &str, io_buf: usize) -> Result<()> {\n        let body = self.serialize();\n        let raw = fs.create_write(tmp_rel)?;\n        let mut w = BufWriter::new(raw, io_buf);\n        w.write_all(body.as_bytes())?;\n        w.sync_all()?;\n        drop(w);\n        fs.rename(tmp_rel, manifest_rel)?;\n        fs.sync_dir(dir_rel)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn serialize(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(MANIFEST_VERSION);\n        s.push('\\n');\n        if let Some(c) = &self.config {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"key={}\\n\", c.key_canonical));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"mem={}\\n\", c.mem));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"buf={}\\n\", c.buf));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"fanin={}\\n\", c.fanin));\n        }\n        for r in &self.runs {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"run {:06} {} {} {}\\n\",\n                r.index, r.rel, r.count, r.aggr_crc\n            ));\n        }\n        for m in &self.merges {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"merge r{:02} {:06} {} {} {} inputs={}\\n\",\n                m.round,\n                m.step,\n                m.rel,\n                m.count,\n                m.aggr_crc,\n                m.inputs.join(\";\")\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.done {\n            s.push_str(\"state DONE\\n\");\n        }\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// Strict parser. Any malformed line is a corruption error; callers\n    /// recovering from a torn manifest handle that at a higher level.\n    pub fn parse(body: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut lines = body.split('\\n');\n        let version = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        if version != MANIFEST_VERSION {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(format!(\"unsupported manifest version: {version:?}\")));\n        }\n\n        let mut m = Manifest::default();\n        let mut saw_state = false;\n        for (lineno, line) in lines.enumerate().map(|(i, l)| (i + 2, l)) {\n            if line.is_empty() {\n                continue; // trailing newline only\n            }\n            let bad = || Error::corrupt(format!(\"manifest line {lineno}: {line:?}\"));\n\n            if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"key=\") {\n                if m.config.is_some() {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                m.config = Some(JobConfig {\n                    key_canonical: v.to_owned(),\n                    mem: 0,\n                    buf: 0,\n                    fanin: 0,\n                });\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"mem=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.mem = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"buf=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.buf = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"fanin=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.fanin = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"run \") {\n                let f: Vec<&str> = rest.split(' ').collect();\n                if f.len() != 4 {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                m.runs.push(RunEntry {\n                    index: f[0].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    rel: f[1].to_owned(),\n                    count: f[2].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    aggr_crc: f[3].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                });\n            } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"merge \") {\n                // merge r00 000001 rel count crc inputs=a;b\n                let f: Vec<&str> = rest.split(' ').collect();\n                if f.len() != 6 || !f[0].starts_with('r') {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                let round: u32 = f[0][1..].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n                let step: u32 = f[1].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n                let inputs: Vec<String> = f[5]\n                    .strip_prefix(\"inputs=\")\n                    .ok_or_else(bad)?\n                    .split(';')\n                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n                    .map(|s| s.to_owned())\n                    .collect();\n                m.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n                    round,\n                    step,\n                    rel: f[2].to_owned(),\n                    count: f[3].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    aggr_crc: f[4].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    inputs,\n                });\n            } else if line == \"state DONE\" {\n                if saw_state {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                saw_state = true;\n                m.done = true;\n            } else {\n                return Err(bad());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Config consistency: either fully present or absent.\n        if let Some(c) = &m.config {\n            if c.mem == 0 || c.buf == 0 || c.fanin == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\"manifest config incomplete\"));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(m)\n    }\n\n    /// Loads the manifest if present; a missing manifest yields the default\n    /// (fresh job). A corrupt manifest is an error rather than silently\n    /// discarded — the caller decides policy.\n    pub fn load(fs: &dyn Fs, rel: &str) -> Result<Option<Manifest>> {\n        if !fs.exists(rel)? {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let mut file = fs.open_read(rel)?;\n        let mut body = Vec::new();\n        let mut chunk = [0u8; 8192];\n        loop {\n            let n = file.read(&mut chunk)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                break;\n            }\n            body.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]);\n        }\n        let body = String::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| Error::corrupt(\"manifest not UTF-8\"))?;\n        Ok(Some(Manifest::parse(&body)?))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn cfg() -> JobConfig {\n        JobConfig { key_canonical: \"0:asc\".into(), mem: 4096, buf: 512, fanin: 4 }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn roundtrip() {\n        let mut m = Manifest::new(cfg());\n        m.runs.push(RunEntry { index: 1, rel: \"runs/x\".into(), count: 3, aggr_crc: 42 });\n        m.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n            round: 0,\n            step: 0,\n            rel: \"merges/y\".into(),\n            count: 3,\n            aggr_crc: 7,\n            inputs: vec![\"runs/a\".into(), \"runs/b\".into()],\n        });\n        let body = m.serialize();\n        let p = Manifest::parse(&body).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(p, m);\n        assert!(!p.done);\n        m.done = true;\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(&m.serialize()).unwrap().done);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_garbage() {\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v2\\n\").is_err());\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nrun x y\\n\").is_err());\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nmem=10\\n\").is_err()); Job manifest: the authoritative recovery state.\n//!\n//! Stored at `jobs/<job>/manifest.txt` and rewritten atomically (temp + fsync\n//! + rename + dir-fsync) on every state transition. Each non-comment line is\n//! one record:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! v1\n//! key=<canonical key spec>\n//! mem=<bytes>\n//! buf=<bytes>\n//! fanin=<effective k>\n//! run 000001 runs/run-000001.tmp final-name runs/run-000001.exs <count> <aggr_crc>\n//! merge r00 000001 merges/... <count> <aggr_crc> inputs=runs/run-000001.exs;...\n//! state DONE\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Recovery rule: runs form an ordered prefix. If a run is missing on disk or\n//! fails verification, it and *every later run plus all merge entries* are\n//! discarded, and the engine replays the input from the record following the\n//! last good run. Merge entries are only trusted when their referenced inputs\n//! match the deterministic merge plan for the surviving run set and the merge\n//! output itself verifies; otherwise the whole merge phase is redone.\n\nuse std::io::Write;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::fs::{BufWriter, Fs, WFile};\n\nconst MANIFEST_VERSION: &str = \"v1\";\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct RunEntry {\n    pub index: u64,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub count: u64,\n    pub aggr_crc: u32,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct MergeEntry {\n    pub round: u32,\n    pub step: u32,\n    pub rel: String,\n    pub count: u64,\n    pub aggr_crc: u32,\n    pub inputs: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// Immutable configuration recorded with the job; a resumed run must match it.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct JobConfig {\n    pub key_canonical: String,\n    pub mem: usize,\n    pub buf: usize,\n    pub fanin: usize,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub config: Option<JobConfig>,\n    pub runs: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merges: Vec<MergeEntry>,\n    pub done: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Manifest {\n    pub fn new(config: JobConfig) -> Self {\n        Manifest { config: Some(config), runs: Vec::new(), merges: Vec::new(), done: false }\n    }\n\n    pub fn config(&self) -> Result<&JobConfig> {\n        self.config.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| Error::corrupt(\"manifest missing config\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Serialises and atomically replaces the manifest (write → fsync → rename\n    /// → dir-fsync).\n    pub fn save(&self, fs: &dyn Fs, manifest_rel: &str, tmp_rel: &str, dir_rel: &str, io_buf: usize) -> Result<()> {\n        let body = self.serialize();\n        let raw = fs.create_write(tmp_rel)?;\n        let mut w = BufWriter::new(raw, io_buf);\n        w.write_all(body.as_bytes())?;\n        w.sync_all()?;\n        drop(w);\n        fs.rename(tmp_rel, manifest_rel)?;\n        fs.sync_dir(dir_rel)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn serialize(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(MANIFEST_VERSION);\n        s.push('\\n');\n        if let Some(c) = &self.config {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"key={}\\n\", c.key_canonical));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"mem={}\\n\", c.mem));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"buf={}\\n\", c.buf));\n            s.push_str(&format!(\"fanin={}\\n\", c.fanin));\n        }\n        for r in &self.runs {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"run {:06} {} {} {}\\n\",\n                r.index, r.rel, r.count, r.aggr_crc\n            ));\n        }\n        for m in &self.merges {\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"merge r{:02} {:06} {} {} {} inputs={}\\n\",\n                m.round,\n                m.step,\n                m.rel,\n                m.count,\n                m.aggr_crc,\n                m.inputs.join(\";\")\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.done {\n            s.push_str(\"state DONE\\n\");\n        }\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// Strict parser. Any malformed line is a corruption error; callers\n    /// recovering from a torn manifest handle that at a higher level.\n    pub fn parse(body: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut lines = body.split('\\n');\n        let version = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        if version != MANIFEST_VERSION {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(format!(\"unsupported manifest version: {version:?}\")));\n        }\n\n        let mut m = Manifest::default();\n        let mut saw_state = false;\n        for (lineno, line) in lines.enumerate().map(|(i, l)| (i + 2, l)) {\n            if line.is_empty() {\n                continue; // trailing newline only\n            }\n            let bad = || Error::corrupt(format!(\"manifest line {lineno}: {line:?}\"));\n\n            if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"key=\") {\n                if m.config.is_some() {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                m.config = Some(JobConfig {\n                    key_canonical: v.to_owned(),\n                    mem: 0,\n                    buf: 0,\n                    fanin: 0,\n                });\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"mem=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.mem = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"buf=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.buf = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"fanin=\") {\n                let c = m.config.as_mut().ok_or_else(bad)?;\n                c.fanin = v.parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n            } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"run \") {\n                let f: Vec<&str> = rest.split(' ').collect();\n                if f.len() != 4 {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                m.runs.push(RunEntry {\n                    index: f[0].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    rel: f[1].to_owned(),\n                    count: f[2].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    aggr_crc: f[3].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                });\n            } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"merge \") {\n                // merge r00 000001 rel count crc inputs=a;b\n                let f: Vec<&str> = rest.split(' ').collect();\n                if f.len() != 6 || !f[0].starts_with('r') {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                let round: u32 = f[0][1..].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n                let step: u32 = f[1].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?;\n                let inputs: Vec<String> = f[5]\n                    .strip_prefix(\"inputs=\")\n                    .ok_or_else(bad)?\n                    .split(';')\n                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n                    .map(|s| s.to_owned())\n                    .collect();\n                m.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n                    round,\n                    step,\n                    rel: f[2].to_owned(),\n                    count: f[3].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    aggr_crc: f[4].parse().map_err(|_| bad())?,\n                    inputs,\n                });\n            } else if line == \"state DONE\" {\n                if saw_state {\n                    return Err(bad());\n                }\n                saw_state = true;\n                m.done = true;\n            } else {\n                return Err(bad());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Config consistency: either fully present or absent.\n        if let Some(c) = &m.config {\n            if c.mem == 0 || c.buf == 0 || c.fanin == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\"manifest config incomplete\"));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(m)\n    }\n\n    /// Loads the manifest if present; a missing manifest yields the default\n    /// (fresh job). A corrupt manifest is an error rather than silently\n    /// discarded — the caller decides policy.\n    pub fn load(fs: &dyn Fs, rel: &str) -> Result<Option<Manifest>> {\n        if !fs.exists(rel)? {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let mut file = fs.open_read(rel)?;\n        let mut body = Vec::new();\n        let mut chunk = [0u8; 8192];\n        loop {\n            let n = file.read(&mut chunk)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                break;\n            }\n            body.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]);\n        }\n        let body = String::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| Error::corrupt(\"manifest not UTF-8\"))?;\n        Ok(Some(Manifest::parse(&body)?))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn cfg() -> JobConfig {\n        JobConfig { key_canonical: \"0:asc\".into(), mem: 4096, buf: 512, fanin: 4 }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn roundtrip() {\n        let mut m = Manifest::new(cfg());\n        m.runs.push(RunEntry { index: 1, rel: \"runs/x\".into(), count: 3, aggr_crc: 42 });\n        m.merges.push(MergeEntry {\n            round: 0,\n            step: 0,\n            rel: \"merges/y\".into(),\n            count: 3,\n            aggr_crc: 7,\n            inputs: vec![\"runs/a\".into(), \"runs/b\".into()],\n        });\n        let body = m.serialize();\n        let p = Manifest::parse(&body).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(p, m);\n        assert!(!p.done);\n        m.done = true;\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(&m.serialize()).unwrap().done);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_garbage() {\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v2\\n\").is_err());\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nrun x y\\n\").is_err());\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nmem=10\\n\").is_err()); // config incomplete\n        assert!(Manifest::parse(\"v1\\nstate DONE\\nstate DONE\\n\").is_err());\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":22,"oldLines":8,"newStart":22,"newLines":6,"lines":[" //! Both `\\n` and `\\r\\n` are accepted as line terminators; a final line not\n//! terminated by a newline is still delivered. The terminator bytes are never\n//! included in the returned record.\n\nuse crate::error::Result;\nuse crate::fs::{BufReader, RFile};\n\npub struct LineReader {\n    inner: BufReader<Box<dyn RFile>>,\n    buf: Vec<u8>,\n    pos: usize,\n    len: usize,\n    eof: bool,\n    bytes_read: u64,\n}\n\nimpl LineReader {\n    pub fn new(file: Box<dyn RFile>, io_buf: usize) -> Self {\n        LineReader {\n            inner: BufReader::new(file, io_buf),\n            buf: vec![0u8; io_buf.max(64)],\n            pos: 0,\n            len: 0,\n            eof: false,\n            bytes_read: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn bytes_read(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.bytes_read\n    }\n\n    fn pull(&mut self) -> Result<bool> {\n        if self.eof {\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n        if self.pos > 0 {\n            self.buf.copy_within(self.pos..self.len, 0);\n            self.len -= self.pos;\n            self.pos = 0;\n        }\n        if self.len == self.buf.len() {\n            // A single line spans more than the whole buffer: grow.\n            let new_len = self.buf.len().saturating_mul(2);\n            self.buf.resize(new_len, 0);\n        }\n        let n = self.inner.read(&mut self.buf[self.len..])?;\n        self.bytes_read = self.bytes_read.saturating_add(n as u64);\n        if n == 0 {\n            self.eof = true;\n        } else {\n            self.len += n;\n        }\n        Ok(n > 0)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the next line without terminator, or `None` at EOF.\n    pub fn read_line(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {\n        loop {\n            if self.pos < self.len {\n                if let Some(rel) = self.buf[self.pos..self.len].iter().position(|&b| b == b'\\n') {\n                    let mut end = self.pos + rel;\n {"parentUuid":"01f5c677-03f3-4afc-bc1c-2af81409fb53","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_84u3vy2dxpm1kc3rz5lx2zjk","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/b/tests/end_to_end.rs","content":"//! End-to-end integration tests against the real filesystem plus the\n//! fault-injecting I/O layer.\n\nuse std::io::Read as _;\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse extsort::engine::{Engine, SortConfig};\nuse extsort::format::Record;\nuse extsort::fs::{overwrite_at, FailState, FailingFs, RealFs};\nuse extsort::key::KeySpec;\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"extsort-test-{}-{}-{}\",\n        tag,\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir\n}\n\nfn write_input(root: &Path, job: &str, lines: &[&str]) {\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    let mut body = String::new();\n    for l in lines {\n        body.push_str(l);\n        body.push('\\n');\n    }\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), body).unwrap();\n}\n\nfn read_output(root: &Path, job: &str) -> String {\n    std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"output.txt\")).unwrap()\n}\n\nfn reference_sort(lines: &[String], spec: &KeySpec) -> Vec<String> {\n    let mut recs: Vec<Record> = lines\n        .iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(seq, l)| Record { seq: seq as u64, line: l.as_bytes().to_vec() })\n        .collect();\n    recs.sort_by(|a, b| spec.cmp(a, b));\n    recs.into_iter().map(|r| String::from_utf8(r.line).unwrap()).collect()\n}\n\nfn split_lines(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {\n    s.lines().map(|l| l.to_owned()).collect()\n}\n\nfn run_engine(root: &Path, job: &str, mem: usize, buf: usize, key: &str) -> extsort::SortStats {\n    let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n    let cfg = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(key).unwrap(),\n        mem,\n        buf,\n        fanin: Some(8),\n    };\n    engine.run(job, &cfg).unwrap()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 1. Empty input\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn empty_input_produces_empty_output() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"empty\");\n    write_input(&root, \"j\", &[]);\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, \"j\", 4096, 512, \"\");\n    assert_eq!(stats.input_records, 0);\n    assert_eq!(stats.runs, 0);\n    assert_eq!(read_output(&root, \"j\"), \"\");\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 2. Small memory forces many runs + multiple merge rounds; result must match\n//    the in-memory reference sort.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn deterministic_lines(n: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    // xorshift32 for reproducibility without a dependency on `rand`.\n    let mut x: u32 = 0x1234_5678;\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);\n    for i in 0..n {\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 17;\n        x ^= x << 5;\n        let groups = [\n            \"alpha\", \"bravo\", \"charlie\", \"delta\", \"echo\", \"foxtrot\", \"golf\", \"hotel\",\n        ];\n        let g = groups[(x as usize) % groups.len()];\n        // Include a second numeric field and duplicate keys to exercise\n        // composite ordering and stability.\n        out.push(format!(\"{g}\\t{:05}\\tid-{i:05}\", x % 7));\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn forced_multi_round_merge_matches_reference() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"multi\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(400);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    let body: String = lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), body).unwrap();\n\n    // Tiny budget: ~200B for records after the I/O buffer -> dozens of runs;\n    // fan-in 3 forces ceil(ceil(runs/3)/3)... multi-round merges.\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, job, 2048, 256, \"1:asc;2:asc\");\n    assert!(stats.runs >= 8, \"expected many runs, got {}\", stats.runs);\n    assert!(stats.merge_rounds >= 2, \"expected >=2 merge rounds, got {}\", stats.merge_rounds);\n\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got.len(), want.len());\n    assert_eq!(got, want, \"external sort disagrees with in-memory reference\");\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 3. Stability: duplicate composite keys keep input order\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn duplicate_keys_keep_input_order() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"stable\");\n    let lines = vec![\"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"a\\tz\", \"same\\tx\"];\n    write_input(&root, \"j\", &lines);\n    run_engine(&root, \"j\", 800, 256, \"1:asc\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, \"j\"));\n    // \"a\\tz\" first, then the four \"same\\tx\" lines in input order.\n    assert_eq!(got, vec![\"a\\tz\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\"]);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn descending_and_composite_order_matches_reference() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"composite\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(120);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n    run_engine(&root, job, 1500, 300, \"2:desc;1:asc\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"2:desc;1:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got, want);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 4. One record much larger than the memory budget (\"超大单行\")\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn oversized_single_line_is_sorted_correctly() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"oversize\");\n    let big = format!(\"huge\\t{}\", \"Z\".repeat(20_000));\n    let smalls: Vec<String> = (0..20).map(|i| format!(\"small\\t{i:03}\")).collect();\n    let mut lines: Vec<String> = smalls.clone();\n    lines.push(big.clone()); // line far exceeds mem=2048\n    lines.extend(smalls.iter().cloned());\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, job, 2048, 256, \"1:asc\");\n    assert!(stats.runs >= 2);\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let mut want = lines.clone();\n    want.sort();\n    // whole-field ascending via field1: all \"huge\" < \"small\"\n    let want_ref = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc\").unwrap());\n    let _ = want;\n    assert_eq!(got.len(), lines.len());\n    assert_eq!(got, want_ref);\n    assert!(got.contains(&big));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 5. Recovery after an injected fsync failure mid phase A\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn recovers_from_injected_sync_failure_in_run_phase() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"syncfail\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(200);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n\n    let state = FailState::new();\n    {\n        let mut s = state.lock().unwrap();\n        s.fail_on_sync = Some(2); // die during the 2nd segment fsync\n    }\n    let first = {\n        let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> =\n            Arc::new(FailingFs::new(Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf())), state.clone()));\n        let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n        let cfg = SortConfig {\n            key: KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap(),\n            mem: 1600,\n            buf: 256,\n            fanin: Some(4),\n        };\n        engine.run(job, &cfg)\n    };\n    assert!(first.is_err(), \"injected failure must surface as an error\");\n\n    // Resume on a clean filesystem: exactly one segment must be reused.\n    let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n    let cfg = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap(),\n        mem: 1600,\n        buf: 256,\n        fanin: Some(4),\n    };\n    let stats = engine.run(job, &cfg).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(stats.runs_reused, 1, \"the committed run before the crash is reused\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got, want);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 6. Recovery after an injected fsync failure during the merge phase\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn recovers_from_injected_sync_failure_in_merge_phase() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"mergefail\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(200);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n\n    // Run formation budget forces ~10 runs; fan-in 3 -> multiple rounds and\n    // multiple merge steps.\n    let form = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap(),\n        mem: 1600,\n        buf: 256,\n        fanin: Some(3),\n    };\n\n    // Prime all runs, then fail on the first *merge* sync.\n    let fs0: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    Engine::new(fs0.clone()).run(job, &form).unwrap();\n    let run_count = fs0\n        .list(&format!(\"jobs/{job}/runs\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|n| n.ends_with(\".exs\"))\n        .count() as u64;\n    assert!(run_count >= 5, \"need several runs, got {run_count}\");\n\n    // Wipe merges + manifest state to force a redo of merging, with an\n    // injected failure a few merge syncs in.\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"merges\")).unwrap();\n    let manifest = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"manifest.txt\");\n    let body = std::fs::read_to_string(&manifest).unwrap();\n    let stripped: String = body\n        .lines()\n        .filter(|l| !l.starts_with(\"merge \") && *l != \"state DONE\")\n        .map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\"))\n        .collect();\n    std::fs::write(&manifest, stripped).unwrap();\n\n    let state = FailState::new();\n    {\n        let mut s = state.lock().unwrap();\n        s.fail_on_sync = Some(2); // second merge step\n    }\n    let attempt = {\n        let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> =\n            Arc::new(FailingFs::new(Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf())), state.clone()));\n        Engine::new(fs).run(job, &form)\n    };\n    assert!(attempt.is_err());\n\n    let stats = Engine::new(Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf())))\n        .run(job, &form)\n        .unwrap();\n    assert!(stats.merges_reused >= 1, \"first merge output should survive\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got, want);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 7. corrupted_run_file_is_detected_and_rebuilt() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"corrupt\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(120);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n\n    let cfg = SortConfig {\n Flip a byte in the trailer (last 8 bytes).\n    *data.last_mut().unwrap() ^= 0xFF;\n    std::fs::write(&p, &data).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(len as usize, data.len());\n\n    let fs: Arc<dyn End-to-end integration tests against the real filesystem plus the\n//! fault-injecting I/O layer.\n\nuse std::io::Read as _;\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse extsort::engine::{Engine, SortConfig};\nuse extsort::format::Record;\nuse extsort::fs::{overwrite_at, FailState, FailingFs, RealFs};\nuse extsort::key::KeySpec;\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"extsort-test-{}-{}-{}\",\n        tag,\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir\n}\n\nfn write_input(root: &Path, job: &str, lines: &[&str]) {\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    let mut body = String::new();\n    for l in lines {\n        body.push_str(l);\n        body.push('\\n');\n    }\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), body).unwrap();\n}\n\nfn read_output(root: &Path, job: &str) -> String {\n    std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"output.txt\")).unwrap()\n}\n\nfn reference_sort(lines: &[String], spec: &KeySpec) -> Vec<String> {\n    let mut recs: Vec<Record> = lines\n        .iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(seq, l)| Record { seq: seq as u64, line: l.as_bytes().to_vec() })\n        .collect();\n    recs.sort_by(|a, b| spec.cmp(a, b));\n    recs.into_iter().map(|r| String::from_utf8(r.line).unwrap()).collect()\n}\n\nfn split_lines(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {\n    s.lines().map(|l| l.to_owned()).collect()\n}\n\nfn run_engine(root: &Path, job: &str, mem: usize, buf: usize, key: &str) -> extsort::SortStats {\n    let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n    let cfg = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(key).unwrap(),\n        mem,\n        buf,\n        fanin: Some(8),\n    };\n    engine.run(job, &cfg).unwrap()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 1. Empty input\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn empty_input_produces_empty_output() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"empty\");\n    write_input(&root, \"j\", &[]);\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, \"j\", 4096, 512, \"\");\n    assert_eq!(stats.input_records, 0);\n    assert_eq!(stats.runs, 0);\n    assert_eq!(read_output(&root, \"j\"), \"\");\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 2. Small memory forces many runs + multiple merge rounds; result must match\n//    the in-memory reference sort.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn deterministic_lines(n: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    // xorshift32 for reproducibility without a dependency on `rand`.\n    let mut x: u32 = 0x1234_5678;\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);\n    for i in 0..n {\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 17;\n        x ^= x << 5;\n        let groups = [\n            \"alpha\", \"bravo\", \"charlie\", \"delta\", \"echo\", \"foxtrot\", \"golf\", \"hotel\",\n        ];\n        let g = groups[(x as usize) % groups.len()];\n        // Include a second numeric field and duplicate keys to exercise\n        // composite ordering and stability.\n        out.push(format!(\"{g}\\t{:05}\\tid-{i:05}\", x % 7));\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn forced_multi_round_merge_matches_reference() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"multi\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(400);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    let body: String = lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), body).unwrap();\n\n    // Tiny budget: ~200B for records after the I/O buffer -> dozens of runs;\n    // fan-in 3 forces ceil(ceil(runs/3)/3)... multi-round merges.\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, job, 2048, 256, \"1:asc;2:asc\");\n    assert!(stats.runs >= 8, \"expected many runs, got {}\", stats.runs);\n    assert!(stats.merge_rounds >= 2, \"expected >=2 merge rounds, got {}\", stats.merge_rounds);\n\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got.len(), want.len());\n    assert_eq!(got, want, \"external sort disagrees with in-memory reference\");\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 3. Stability: duplicate composite keys keep input order\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn duplicate_keys_keep_input_order() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"stable\");\n    let lines = vec![\"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"a\\tz\", \"same\\tx\"];\n    write_input(&root, \"j\", &lines);\n    run_engine(&root, \"j\", 800, 256, \"1:asc\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, \"j\"));\n    // \"a\\tz\" first, then the four \"same\\tx\" lines in input order.\n    assert_eq!(got, vec![\"a\\tz\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\", \"same\\tx\"]);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn descending_and_composite_order_matches_reference() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"composite\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(120);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n    run_engine(&root, job, 1500, 300, \"2:desc;1:asc\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"2:desc;1:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got, want);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 4. One record much larger than the memory budget (\"超大单行\")\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn oversized_single_line_is_sorted_correctly() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"oversize\");\n    let big = format!(\"huge\\t{}\", \"Z\".repeat(20_000));\n    let smalls: Vec<String> = (0..20).map(|i| format!(\"small\\t{i:03}\")).collect();\n    let mut lines: Vec<String> = smalls.clone();\n    lines.push(big.clone()); // line far exceeds mem=2048\n    lines.extend(smalls.iter().cloned());\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, job, 2048, 256, \"1:asc\");\n    assert!(stats.runs >= 2);\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let mut want = lines.clone();\n    want.sort();\n    // whole-field ascending via field1: all \"huge\" < \"small\"\n    let want_ref = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc\").unwrap());\n    let _ = want;\n    assert_eq!(got.len(), lines.len());\n    assert_eq!(got, want_ref);\n    assert!(got.contains(&big));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 5. Recovery after an injected fsync failure mid phase A\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn recovers_from_injected_sync_failure_in_run_phase() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"syncfail\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(200);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect::<String>()).unwrap();\n\n    let state = FailState::new();\n    {\n        let mut s = state.lock().unwrap();\n        s.fail_on_sync = Some(2); // die during the 2nd segment fsync\n    }\n    let first = {\n        let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> =\n            Arc::new(FailingFs::new(Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf())), state.clone()));\n        let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n        let cfg = SortConfig {\n            key: KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap(),\n            mem: 1600,\n            buf: 256,\n            fanin: Some(4),\n        };\n        engine.run(job, &cfg)\n    };\n    assert!(first.is_err(), \"injected failure must surface as an error\");\n\n    // Resume on a clean filesystem: exactly one segment must be reused.\n    let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n    let cfg = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap(),\n        mem: 1600,\n        buf: 256,\n        fanin: Some(4),\n    };\n    let stats = engine.run(job, &cfg).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(stats.runs_reused, 1, \"the committed run before the crash is reused\");\n    let got = split_lines(&read_output(&root, job));\n    let want = reference_sort(&lines, &KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap());\n    assert_eq!(got, want);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 6. fan-in 3 -> multiple rounds and\n    // multiple merge steps.\n    let form = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc;2:asc\").unwrap(),\n        mem: 1600,\n        buf: 256,\n        fanin: Some(3),\n    };\n\n    // Prime all runs, then fail on the first *merge* sync.\n    let fs0: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    Engine::new(fs0.clone()).run(job, &form).unwrap();\n    let run_count = fs0\n        .list(&format!(\"jobs/{job}/runs\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|n| n.ends_with(\".exs\"))\n        .count() as u64;\n    assert!(run_count >= 5, \"need several runs, got {run_count}\");\n\n    // Wipe merges + manifest state to force a redo of merging, with an\n    // injected failure a few merge syncs in.\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"merges\")).unwrap();\n    let manifest = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"manifest.txt\");\n    let body = std::fs::read_to_string(&manifest).unwrap();\n    let stripped: String = body\n        .lines()\n        .filter(|l| !l.starts_with(\"merge \") && *l != \"state DONE\")\n        .map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\"))\n        .collect();\n    std::fs::write(&manifest, stripped).unwrap();\n\n    let state = FailState::new();\n    {\n        let mut s = state.lock().unwrap();\n        s.fail_on_sync = Some(2); End-to-end integration tests against the real filesystem plus the\n//! fault-injecting I/O layer.\n\nuse std::io::Read as _;\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse extsort::engine::{Engine, SortConfig};\nuse extsort::format::Record;\nuse extsort::fs::{overwrite_at, FailState, FailingFs, RealFs};\nuse extsort::key::KeySpec;\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"extsort-test-{}-{}-{}\",\n        tag,\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir\n}\n\nfn write_input(root: &Path, job: &str, lines: &[&str]) {\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    let mut body = String::new();\n    for l in lines {\n        body.push_str(l);\n        body.push('\\n');\n    }\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), body).unwrap();\n}\n\nfn read_output(root: &Path, job: &str) -> String {\n    std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(\"jobs\").join(job).join(\"output.txt\")).unwrap()\n}\n\nfn reference_sort(lines: &[String], spec: &KeySpec) -> Vec<String> {\n    let mut recs: Vec<Record> = lines\n        .iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(seq, l)| Record { seq: seq as u64, line: l.as_bytes().to_vec() })\n        .collect();\n    recs.sort_by(|a, b| spec.cmp(a, b));\n    recs.into_iter().map(|r| String::from_utf8(r.line).unwrap()).collect()\n}\n\nfn split_lines(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {\n    s.lines().map(|l| l.to_owned()).collect()\n}\n\nfn run_engine(root: &Path, job: &str, mem: usize, buf: usize, key: &str) -> extsort::SortStats {\n    let fs: Arc<dyn extsort::fs::Fs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new(root.to_path_buf()));\n    let engine = Engine::new(fs);\n    let cfg = SortConfig {\n        key: KeySpec::parse(key).unwrap(),\n        mem,\n        buf,\n        fanin: Some(8),\n    };\n    engine.run(job, &cfg).unwrap()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 1. Empty input\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn empty_input_produces_empty_output() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"empty\");\n    write_input(&root, \"j\", &[]);\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, \"j\", 4096, 512, \"\");\n    assert_eq!(stats.input_records, 0);\n    assert_eq!(stats.runs, 0);\n    assert_eq!(read_output(&root, \"j\"), \"\");\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 2. Small memory forces many runs + multiple merge rounds; result must match\n//    the in-memory reference sort.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn deterministic_lines(n: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    // xorshift32 for reproducibility without a dependency on `rand`.\n    let mut x: u32 = 0x1234_5678;\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);\n    for i in 0..n {\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 17;\n        x ^= x << 5;\n        let groups = [\n            \"alpha\", \"bravo\", \"charlie\", \"delta\", \"echo\", \"foxtrot\", \"golf\", \"hotel\",\n        ];\n        let g = groups[(x as usize) % groups.len()];\n        // Include a second numeric field and duplicate keys to exercise\n        // composite ordering and stability.\n        out.push(format!(\"{g}\\t{:05}\\tid-{i:05}\", x % 7));\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn forced_multi_round_merge_matches_reference() {\n    let root = temp_dir(\"multi\");\n    let lines = deterministic_lines(400);\n    let job = \"j\";\n    let dir = root.join(\"jobs\").join(job);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    let body: String = lines.iter().map(|l| format!(\"{l}\\n\")).collect();\n    std::fs::write(dir.join(\"input.txt\"), body).unwrap();\n\n    // Tiny budget: ~200B for records after the I/O buffer -> dozens of runs;\n    // fan-in 3 forces ceil(ceil(runs/3)/3)... multi-round merges.\n    let stats = run_engine(&root, job, 2048, 256, \"1:asc;2:asc\");\n    assert!(stats.runs >= 8, \"expected many runs, got {}\", stats.runs);\n
